1919 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1920 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1921 |     try:
1922 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1923 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1924 |         
1925 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1926 |         if period == "today":
1927 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1928 |         elif period == "week":
1929 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1930 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1931 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1932 |         elif period == "month":
1933 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1934 |         else: # "all"
1935 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1936 | 
1937 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1938 |         stats = {
1939 |             "new": 0,
1940 |             "interested": 0,
1941 |             "pending": 0,
1942 |             "confirmed": 0,
1943 |             "completed": 0,
1944 |             "cancelled": 0,
1945 |             "no_response": 0,
1946 |             "archive": 0
1947 |         }
1948 | 
1949 |         for user in users_data:
1950 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1951 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1952 |             if not user_date_str:
1953 |                 continue
1954 |                 
1955 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1956 |             
1957 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1958 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1959 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1960 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1961 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1962 |                 else:
1963 |                     status = user.get("status")
1964 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1965 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1966 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1967 |                     
1968 |                     if status in stats:
1969 |                         stats[status] += 1
1970 | 
1971 |         return {
1972 |             "status": "ok",
1973 |             "period": period,
1974 |             "stats": stats
1975 |         }
1976 | 
1977 |     except Exception as e:
1978 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1979 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2131 |             else:

2145 |

2152 |         }

2627 | @app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/send_message")
2628 | async def send_message_to_user(msg_request: SendMessageRequest):
2629 |     """Отправить сообщение пользователю через Telegram бота"""
2630 |     try:
2631 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2632 |         
2633 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2634 |         try:
2635 |             chat_log_entry = {
2636 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2637 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2638 |                 "role": "manager",
2639 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2640 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2641 |             }
2642 |             
2643 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2644 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2645 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2646 |         except Exception as log_error:
2647 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2648 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2649 |         
2650 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2651 |         update_dialog_status(
2652 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2653 |             active=True,
2654 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2655 |             last_message_from="manager",
2656 |             message_count_increment=1
2657 |         )
2658 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2659 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2660 |         )
2661 |         
2662 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2663 |         try:
2664 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2665 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2666 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2667 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2668 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2669 |             
2670 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2671 |             
2672 |             response = requests.post(
2673 |                 internal_endpoint,
2674 |                 json={
2675 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2676 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2677 |                 },
2678 |                 timeout=10,
2679 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2680 |             )
2681 |             
2682 |             if response.status_code == 200:
2683 |                 result = response.json()
2684 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2685 |                 return {
2686 |                     "status": "ok",
2687 |                     "message": "Message sent successfully",
2688 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2689 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2690 |                 }
2691 |             else:
2692 |                 print(f"⚠️ Bot returned status {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
2693 |                 return {
2694 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2695 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2696 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2697 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2698 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2699 |                 }
2700 |                 
2701 |         except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
2702 |             print(f"⚠️ Error connecting to bot: {e}")
2703 |             return {
2704 |                 "status": "partial_success",
2705 |                 "message": "Message logged but bot unreachable",
2706 |                 "logged_to_history": True,
2707 |                 "sent_via_bot": False,
2708 |                 "bot_error": str(e)
2709 |             }
2710 |             
2711 |     except Exception as e:
2712 |         print(f"❌ Error in send_message: {e}")
2713 |         import traceback
2714 |         traceback.print_exc()
2715 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2719 | async def receive_message_from_bot(request: Request):
2720 |     """Receive message from Telegram bot and log it"""
2721 |     try:
2722 |         data = await request.json()
2723 |         user_id = data.get('user_id')
2724 |         text = data.get('text')
2725 |         username = data.get('username')
2726 |         timestamp = data.get('timestamp')
2727 |         
2728 |         if not user_id or not text:
2729 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and text are required")
2730 |         
2731 |         print(f"📨 Received message from bot: user {user_id}, text: {text[:50]}...")
2732 |         
2733 |         # 1. Log message to chat history with role "user"
2734 |         try:
2735 |             chat_log_entry = {
2736 |                 "timestamp": timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2737 |                 "user_id": user_id,
2738 |                 "role": "user",
2739 |                 "text": text,
2740 |                 "username": username,
2741 |                 "source": "telegram_bot"
2742 |             }
2743 |             
2744 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2745 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2746 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {user_id}")
2747 |         except Exception as log_error:
2748 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2749 |         
2750 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: новое сообщение от пользователя
2751 |         update_dialog_status(
2752 |             user_id=user_id,
2753 |             active=True,
2754 |             has_new_messages=True,
2755 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2756 |             last_message_from="user",
2757 |             message_count_increment=1,
2758 |             username=username
2759 |         )
2760 |         log_dialog_event(user_id,action="receive_message_from_bot",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
2761 |         
2762 |         # 3. Update user metadata (last message time) to move them up in CRM chat list
2763 |         try:
2764 |             users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
2765 |             user_updated = False
2766 |             
2767 |             for user in users_data:
2768 |                 if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
2769 |                     user['last_message_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2770 |                     user['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2771 |                     user_updated = True

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default
 433 | 
 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):
 435 |     tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
 436 |     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)
 439 | 
 440 | def as_cars_list(data: Any) -> List[Dict]:
 441 |     if isinstance(data, dict) and "cars" in data:
 442 |         return list(data["cars"].values())
 443 |     if isinstance(data, list):
 444 |         return data
 445 |     if isinstance(data, dict):
 446 |         return list(data.values())
 447 |     return []
 448 | 
 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 | 
 476 | def gen_booking_id() -> str:
 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
 478 |

 493 | def get_user_latest_record(user_id: int, from_archive: bool = False):
 494 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if from_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 495 |     users_data = load_json(json_file)
 496 |     user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 497 |     if not user_records:
 498 |         return None
 499 |     user_records.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('timestamp', ''), reverse=True)
 500 |     return user_records[0]

 502 | def update_all_user_records(user_id: int, updates: dict, in_archive: bool = False):
 503 |     """Обновить все записи пользователя"""
 504 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if in_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 505 |     
 506 |     if not json_file.exists():
 507 |         return False
 508 |     
 509 |     with open(json_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 510 |         users_data = json.load(f)
 511 |     
 512 |     updated = False
 513 |     for user in users_data:
 514 |         if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
 515 |             user.update(updates)
 516 |             updated = True
 517 |     
 518 |     if updated:
 519 |         with _lock:
 520 |             save_json(json_file, users_data)
 521 |     
 522 |     return updated

 525 | def move_to_archive(user_id: int):
 526 |     """Переместить пользователя в архив"""
 527 |     try:
 528 |         print(f"🗂️ Moving user {user_id} to archive...")
 529 |         
 530 |         # Читаем user_data
 531 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 532 |             print(f"❌ USER_DATA_JSON not found: {USER_DATA_JSON}")
 533 |             return False
 534 |         
 535 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 536 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 537 |         
 538 |         print(f"📊 Total records in user_data: {len(users_data)}")
 539 |         
 540 |         # Находим все записи пользователя
 541 |         user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 542 |         if not user_records:
 543 |             print(f"❌ User {user_id} not found in user_data")
 544 |             return False
 545 |         
 546 |         print(f"📋 Found {len(user_records)} records for user {user_id}")
 547 |         
 548 |         # Читаем архив
 549 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 550 |             print(f"📁 Creating new archive file: {ARCHIVE_JSON}")
 551 |             archive_data = []
 552 |         else:
 553 |             with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 554 |                 archive_data = json.load(f)
 555 |         
 556 |         print(f"📊 Current archive size: {len(archive_data)} records")
 557 |         
 558 |         # Переносим в архив
 559 |         for record in user_records:
 560 |             record['archived_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 561 |             archive_data.append(record)
 562 |         
 563 |         # Удаляем из user_data
 564 |         users_data = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 565 |         
 566 |         # Сохраняем
 567 |         with _lock:
 568 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 569 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 570 |         
 571 |         print(f"✅ Moved user {user_id} to archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 572 |         print(f"📊 New user_data size: {len(users_data)}")
 573 |         print(f"📊 New archive size: {len(archive_data)}")
 574 |         
 575 |         return True
 576 |         
 577 |     except Exception as e:
 578 |         print(f"❌ Error moving to archive: {e}")
 579 |         import traceback
 580 |         traceback.print_exc()
 581 |         return False

 583 | def restore_from_archive(user_id: int):
 584 |     """Восстановить пользователя из архива"""
 585 |     try:
 586 |         # Читаем архив
 587 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 588 |             return False
 589 |         
 590 |         with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 591 |             archive_data = json.load(f)
 592 |         
 593 |         # Находим записи пользователя
 594 |         user_records = [u for u in archive_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 595 |         if not user_records:
 596 |             return False
 597 |         
 598 |         # Читаем user_data
 599 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 600 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 601 |         
 602 |         # Восстанавливаем в user_data со статусом "В работе"
 603 |         for record in user_records:
 604 |             record['final_status'] = 'in_progress'
 605 |             record['restored_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 606 |             if 'archived_at' in record:
 607 |                 del record['archived_at']
 608 |             users_data.append(record)
 609 |         
 610 |         # Удаляем из архива
 611 |         archive_data = [u for u in archive_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 612 |         
 613 |         # Сохраняем
 614 |         with _lock:
 615 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 616 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 617 |         
 618 |         print(f"✅ Restored user {user_id} from archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 619 |         return True
 620 |         
 621 |     except Exception as e:
 622 |         print(f"❌ Error restoring from archive: {e}")

 626 | def auto_archive_old_records():
 627 |     """Автоматическая архивация старых записей"""
 628 |     try:
 629 |         from datetime import timedelta
 630 |         
 631 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 632 |             return {"archived": 0, "errors": 0}
 633 |         
 634 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 635 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 636 |         
 637 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
 638 |         to_archive = []
 639 |         
 640 |         # Правила архивации
 641 |         for user in users_data:
 642 |             timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 643 |             try:
 644 |                 user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 645 |             except:
 646 |                 continue
 647 |             
 648 |             age_days = (now - user_time).days
 649 |             status = user.get('final_status', '')
 650 |             
 651 |             # Правила:
 652 |             should_archive = False
 653 |             
 654 |             if status == 'new' and age_days > 14:
 655 |                 should_archive = True  # Новые > 2 недели
 656 |             elif status == 'awaiting_followup' and age_days > 30:
 657 |                 should_archive = True  # Теплые > 1 месяц
 658 |             elif status in ['rejected', 'new']:
 659 |                 should_archive = True  # Отказы и холодные сразу
 660 |             elif status == 'completed':
 661 |                 should_archive = True  # Завершенные сразу
 662 |             
 663 |             if should_archive:
 664 |                 to_archive.append(user.get('user_id'))
 665 |         
 666 |         # Архивируем
 667 |         archived_count = 0
 668 |         for user_id in set(to_archive):  # unique user_ids
 669 |             if move_to_archive(user_id):
 670 |                 archived_count += 1
 671 |         
 672 |         print(f"✅ Auto-archived {archived_count} users")
 673 |         return {"archived": archived_count, "errors": 0}
 674 |         
 675 |     except Exception as e:
 676 |         print(f"❌ Error in auto_archive: {e}")
 677 |         return {"archived": 0, "errors": 1}

 680 | def filter_by_period(users_data: list, period: str) -> list:
 681 |     """Фильтровать записи по периоду"""
 682 |     from datetime import timedelta
 683 |     
 684 |     if period == 'all':
 685 |         return users_data
 686 |     
 687 |     now = datetime.utcnow()
 688 |     
 689 |     # Определяем период
 690 |     if period == 'today':
 691 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=1)
 692 |     elif period == 'week':
 693 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
 694 |     elif period == '2weeks':
 695 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=14)
 696 |     elif period == 'month':
 697 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
 698 |     else:
 699 |         return users_data
 700 |     
 701 |     # Фильтруем
 702 |     filtered = []
 703 |     for user in users_data:
 704 |         timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 705 |         try:
 706 |             user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 707 |             if user_time >= cutoff:
 708 |                 filtered.append(user)
 709 |         except:
 710 |             continue
 711 |     
 712 |     return filtered

 714 | def determine_category(car_name: str) -> str:

 716 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['yaris', 'ativ', 'city', 'mazda2', 'mg5']):
 717 |         return 'compact'
 718 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['civic', 'altis', 'camry', 'corolla']):

 720 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['hrv', 'cx3', 'cx30', 'fortuner', 'xforce', 'mux']):
 721 |         return 'suv'
 722 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['xpander', 'veloz']):
 723 |         return '7s'
 724 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['pcx', 'click', 'bike', 'скутер', 'мото']):
 725 |         return 'bikes'
 726 |     return 'sedan'

 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

1078 | def initiate_claude_dialogue(user_id, user_filters=None):
1079 |     """Запускает диалог Claude с подбором машин"""
1080 |     print(f"🤖 Initiating Claude dialogue for user {user_id}")
1081 |     
1082 |     if user_id in user_conversations and user_conversations[user_id].get("status") == "active":
1083 |         print(f"Dialogue with user {user_id} is already active.")
1084 |         return {"status": "already_active", "message": "Диалог уже активен"}
1085 |     
1086 |     if user_id in user_sessions and user_sessions[user_id].get("claude_initiated"):
1087 |         print(f"Claude already initiated for user {user_id}.")
1088 |         return {"status": "already_initiated", "message": "Claude уже был инициализирован"}
1089 |     
1090 |     try:
1091 |         # Активируем диалог сразу
1092 |         user_conversations[user_id] = {
1093 |             "status": "active",
1094 |             "history": [],
1095 |             "filters": user_filters or {}
1096 |         }
1097 |         
1098 |         if user_id not in user_sessions:
1099 |             user_sessions[user_id] = {}
1100 |         user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
1101 | 
1102 |         # Сразу запускаем подбор вариантов
1103 |         handle_claude_best_options(user_id)
1104 |         
1105 |         print(f"✅ Claude dialogue initiated for user {user_id}")
1106 |         return {"status": "success", "message": "Диалог Claude запущен"}
1107 |         
1108 |     except Exception as e:
1109 |         print(f"❌ Failed to initiate dialogue with user {user_id}: {e}")
1110 |         import traceback
1111 |         traceback.print_exc()
1112 |         return {"status": "error", "message": f"Ошибка запуска диалога: {str(e)}"}

1114 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):
1115 |     """Claude генерирует текст и отправляет его на внутренний эндпоинт для доставки юзеру"""
1116 |     try:
1117 |         # 1. Получаем данные из диалогов (как и раньше)
1118 |         if user_id not in user_conversations:
1119 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден"}
1120 |         
1121 |         user_filters = user_conversations[user_id].get("filters") or {}
1122 |         days = user_filters.get('days', '')
1123 |         start_date = user_filters.get('start_date', '')
1124 |         end_date = user_filters.get('end_date', '')
1125 |         
1126 |         date_info = f"{start_date} — {end_date}" if start_date else f"{days} дн."
1127 | 
1128 |         # 2. Формируем краткий промпт (только квалификация)
1129 |         user_request = (
1130 |             f"Начни ответ СТРОГО с фразы: 'Ищешь что-то определенное? Могу подсказать.' "
1131 |             f"Задай ОДИН короткий вопрос касающий потребности снять транспорт на Пхукете."
1132 |         )
1133 |         
1134 |         # 3. Получаем текст от Клода
1135 |         result = process_claude_message(user_id, user_request)

1210 |                     f"Депозит: {deposit}฿\n"
1211 |                 )

1214 |                 photos = car.get('photos', {})

1216 |                 # Main фото

1218 |                 if main_photo:
1219 |                     cars_context += f"Главное фото: [image:{main_photo}]\n"
1220 |

1225 |                     cars_context += f"Все фото: {gallery_paths}\n"
1226 |

1229 |         system_prompt += """

1231 | ПРАВИЛА ОТПРАВКИ ФОТО:

1235 | - НЕ отправляй все фото сразу без запроса
1236 | """
1237 |

1350 |

1852 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1853 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1854 |     try:
1855 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1856 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1857 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1858 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1859 | 
1860 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1861 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1862 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1863 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1864 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1865 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1866 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1867 |     except Exception as e:
1868 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1879 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1880 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1881 |     try:
1882 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1883 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1884 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1885 | 
1886 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1887 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1888 | 
1889 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1890 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1891 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1892 | 
1893 |         # Фильтрация
1894 |         filtered = []
1895 |         for u in users_data:
1896 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1897 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1898 |             
1899 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1900 |             
1901 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1902 |             
1903 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1904 |                 filtered.append(u)
1905 | 
1906 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1907 | 
1908 |         return {
1909 |             "status": "ok",
1910 |             "users": filtered
1911 |         }
1912 |     except Exception as e:
1913 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1914 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1919 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1920 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1921 |     try:
1922 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1923 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1924 |         
1925 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1926 |         if period == "today":
1927 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1928 |         elif period == "week":
1929 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1930 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1931 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1932 |         elif period == "month":
1933 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1934 |         else: # "all"
1935 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1936 | 
1937 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1938 |         stats = {
1939 |             "new": 0,
1940 |             "interested": 0,
1941 |             "pending": 0,
1942 |             "confirmed": 0,
1943 |             "completed": 0,
1944 |             "cancelled": 0,
1945 |             "no_response": 0,
1946 |             "archive": 0
1947 |         }
1948 | 
1949 |         for user in users_data:
1950 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1951 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1952 |             if not user_date_str:
1953 |                 continue
1954 |                 
1955 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1956 |             
1957 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1958 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1959 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1960 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1961 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1962 |                 else:
1963 |                     status = user.get("status")
1964 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1965 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1966 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1967 |                     
1968 |                     if status in stats:
1969 |                         stats[status] += 1
1970 | 
1971 |         return {
1972 |             "status": "ok",
1973 |             "period": period,
1974 |             "stats": stats
1975 |         }
1976 | 
1977 |     except Exception as e:
1978 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1979 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2131 |             else:

2623 |     text: str
2624 |     role: str = "manager"

2626 | 
2627 | @app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/send_message")
2628 | async def send_message_to_user(msg_request: SendMessageRequest):
2629 |     """Отправить сообщение пользователю через Telegram бота"""
2630 |     try:
2631 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2632 |         
2633 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2634 |         try:
2635 |             chat_log_entry = {
2636 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2637 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2638 |                 "role": "manager",
2639 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2640 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2641 |             }
2642 |             
2643 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2644 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2645 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2646 |         except Exception as log_error:
2647 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2648 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2649 |         
2650 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2651 |         update_dialog_status(
2652 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2653 |             active=True,
2654 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2655 |             last_message_from="manager",
2656 |             message_count_increment=1
2657 |         )
2658 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2659 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2660 |         )
2661 |         
2662 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2663 |         try:
2664 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2665 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2666 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2667 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2668 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2669 |             
2670 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2671 |             
2672 |             response = requests.post(
2673 |                 internal_endpoint,
2674 |                 json={
2675 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,

async def api_send_claude_message(request: Request):
    """Отправляет сообщение в диалог Claude"""
    try:
        data = await request.json()
        user_id = data.get('user_id')
        message = data.get('message')
        
        if not user_id or not message:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and message required")

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default
 433 | 
 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):
 435 |     tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
 436 |     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)
 439 | 
 440 | def as_cars_list(data: Any) -> List[Dict]:
 441 |     if isinstance(data, dict) and "cars" in data:
 442 |         return list(data["cars"].values())
 443 |     if isinstance(data, list):
 444 |         return data
 445 |     if isinstance(data, dict):
 446 |         return list(data.values())
 447 |     return []

 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 | 
 476 | def gen_booking_id() -> str:
 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
 478 |

 493 | def get_user_latest_record(user_id: int, from_archive: bool = False):
 494 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if from_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 495 |     users_data = load_json(json_file)
 496 |     user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 497 |     if not user_records:
 498 |         return None
 499 |     user_records.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('timestamp', ''), reverse=True)
 500 |     return user_records[0]

 502 | def update_all_user_records(user_id: int, updates: dict, in_archive: bool = False):
 503 |     """Обновить все записи пользователя"""
 504 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if in_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 505 |     
 506 |     if not json_file.exists():
 507 |         return False
 508 |     
 509 |     with open(json_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 510 |         users_data = json.load(f)
 511 |     
 512 |     updated = False
 513 |     for user in users_data:
 514 |         if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
 515 |             user.update(updates)
 516 |             updated = True
 517 |     
 518 |     if updated:
 519 |         with _lock:
 520 |             save_json(json_file, users_data)
 521 |     
 522 |     return updated

 525 | def move_to_archive(user_id: int):
 526 |     """Переместить пользователя в архив"""
 527 |     try:
 528 |         print(f"🗂️ Moving user {user_id} to archive...")
 529 |         
 530 |         # Читаем user_data
 531 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 532 |             print(f"❌ USER_DATA_JSON not found: {USER_DATA_JSON}")
 533 |             return False
 534 |         
 535 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 536 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 537 |         
 538 |         print(f"📊 Total records in user_data: {len(users_data)}")
 539 |         
 540 |         # Находим все записи пользователя
 541 |         user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 542 |         if not user_records:
 543 |             print(f"❌ User {user_id} not found in user_data")
 544 |             return False
 545 |         
 546 |         print(f"📋 Found {len(user_records)} records for user {user_id}")
 547 |         
 548 |         # Читаем архив
 549 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 550 |             print(f"📁 Creating new archive file: {ARCHIVE_JSON}")
 551 |             archive_data = []
 552 |         else:
 553 |             with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 554 |                 archive_data = json.load(f)
 555 |         
 556 |         print(f"📊 Current archive size: {len(archive_data)} records")
 557 |         
 558 |         # Переносим в архив
 559 |         for record in user_records:
 560 |             record['archived_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 561 |             archive_data.append(record)
 562 |         
 563 |         # Удаляем из user_data
 564 |         users_data = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 565 |         
 566 |         # Сохраняем
 567 |         with _lock:
 568 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 569 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 570 |         
 571 |         print(f"✅ Moved user {user_id} to archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 572 |         print(f"📊 New user_data size: {len(users_data)}")
 573 |         print(f"📊 New archive size: {len(archive_data)}")
 574 |         
 575 |         return True
 576 |         
 577 |     except Exception as e:
 578 |         print(f"❌ Error moving to archive: {e}")
 579 |         import traceback
 580 |         traceback.print_exc()
 581 |         return False

 594 |         user_records = [u for u in archive_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 595 |         if not user_records:
 596 |             return False
 597 |         
 598 |         # Читаем user_data
 599 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 600 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 601 |         
 602 |         # Восстанавливаем в user_data со статусом "В работе"
 603 |         for record in user_records:
 604 |             record['final_status'] = 'in_progress'
 605 |             record['restored_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 606 |             if 'archived_at' in record:
 607 |                 del record['archived_at']
 608 |             users_data.append(record)

 610 |         # Удаляем из архива

 614 |         with _lock:

 616 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)

 618 |         print(f"✅ Restored user {user_id} from archive ({len(user_records)} records)")

 621 |     except Exception as e:

 626 | def auto_archive_old_records():
 627 |     """Автоматическая архивация старых записей"""
 628 |     try:
 629 |         from datetime import timedelta
 630 |         
 631 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 632 |             return {"archived": 0, "errors": 0}
 633 |         
 634 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 635 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 636 |         
 637 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
 638 |         to_archive = []
 639 |         
 640 |         # Правила архивации
 641 |         for user in users_data:
 642 |             timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 643 |             try:
 644 |                 user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 645 |             except:
 646 |                 continue
 647 |             
 648 |             age_days = (now - user_time).days
 649 |             status = user.get('final_status', '')
 650 |             
 651 |             # Правила:
 652 |             should_archive = False
 653 |             
 654 |             if status == 'new' and age_days > 14:
 655 |                 should_archive = True  # Новые > 2 недели
 656 |             elif status == 'awaiting_followup' and age_days > 30:
 657 |                 should_archive = True  # Теплые > 1 месяц
 658 |             elif status in ['rejected', 'new']:
 659 |                 should_archive = True  # Отказы и холодные сразу
 660 |             elif status == 'completed':
 661 |                 should_archive = True  # Завершенные сразу
 662 |             
 663 |             if should_archive:
 664 |                 to_archive.append(user.get('user_id'))
 665 |         
 666 |         # Архивируем
 667 |         archived_count = 0
 668 |         for user_id in set(to_archive):  # unique user_ids
 669 |             if move_to_archive(user_id):
 670 |                 archived_count += 1
 671 |         
 672 |         print(f"✅ Auto-archived {archived_count} users")
 673 |         return {"archived": archived_count, "errors": 0}
 674 |         
 675 |     except Exception as e:
 676 |         print(f"❌ Error in auto_archive: {e}")
 677 |         return {"archived": 0, "errors": 1}

 680 | def filter_by_period(users_data: list, period: str) -> list:
 681 |     """Фильтровать записи по периоду"""
 682 |     from datetime import timedelta
 683 |     
 684 |     if period == 'all':
 685 |         return users_data
 686 |     
 687 |     now = datetime.utcnow()
 688 |     
 689 |     # Определяем период
 690 |     if period == 'today':
 691 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=1)
 692 |     elif period == 'week':
 693 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
 694 |     elif period == '2weeks':
 695 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=14)
 696 |     elif period == 'month':
 697 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
 698 |     else:
 699 |         return users_data
 700 |     
 701 |     # Фильтруем
 702 |     filtered = []
 703 |     for user in users_data:
 704 |         timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 705 |         try:
 706 |             user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 707 |             if user_time >= cutoff:
 708 |                 filtered.append(user)
 709 |         except:
 710 |             continue
 711 |     
 712 |     return filtered

 714 | def determine_category(car_name: str) -> str:

 718 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['civic', 'altis', 'camry', 'corolla']):

 722 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['xpander', 'veloz']):
 723 |         return '7s'
 724 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['pcx', 'click', 'bike', 'скутер', 'мото']):
 725 |         return 'bikes'
 726 |     return 'sedan'

 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

1078 | def initiate_claude_dialogue(user_id, user_filters=None):
1079 |     """Запускает диалог Claude с подбором машин"""
1080 |     print(f"🤖 Initiating Claude dialogue for user {user_id}")
1081 |     
1082 |     if user_id in user_conversations and user_conversations[user_id].get("status") == "active":
1083 |         print(f"Dialogue with user {user_id} is already active.")
1084 |         return {"status": "already_active", "message": "Диалог уже активен"}
1085 |     
1086 |     if user_id in user_sessions and user_sessions[user_id].get("claude_initiated"):
1087 |         print(f"Claude already initiated for user {user_id}.")
1088 |         return {"status": "already_initiated", "message": "Claude уже был инициализирован"}
1089 |     
1090 |     try:
1091 |         # Активируем диалог сразу
1092 |         user_conversations[user_id] = {
1093 |             "status": "active",
1094 |             "history": [],
1095 |             "filters": user_filters or {}
1096 |         }
1097 |         
1098 |         if user_id not in user_sessions:
1099 |             user_sessions[user_id] = {}
1100 |         user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
1101 | 
1102 |         # Сразу запускаем подбор вариантов
1103 |         handle_claude_best_options(user_id)
1104 |         
1105 |         print(f"✅ Claude dialogue initiated for user {user_id}")
1106 |         return {"status": "success", "message": "Диалог Claude запущен"}
1107 |         
1108 |     except Exception as e:
1109 |         print(f"❌ Failed to initiate dialogue with user {user_id}: {e}")
1110 |         import traceback
1111 |         traceback.print_exc()
1112 |         return {"status": "error", "message": f"Ошибка запуска диалога: {str(e)}"}
1113 | 
1114 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):
1115 |     """Claude генерирует текст и отправляет его на внутренний эндпоинт для доставки юзеру"""
1116 |     try:
1117 |         # 1. Получаем данные из диалогов (как и раньше)
1118 |         if user_id not in user_conversations:
1119 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден"}
1120 |         
1121 |         user_filters = user_conversations[user_id].get("filters") or {}
1122 |         days = user_filters.get('days', '')
1123 |         start_date = user_filters.get('start_date', '')
1124 |         end_date = user_filters.get('end_date', '')
1125 |         
1126 |         date_info = f"{start_date} — {end_date}" if start_date else f"{days} дн."
1127 | 
1128 |         # 2. Формируем краткий промпт (только квалификация)
1129 |         user_request = (

1184 |

1196 |

1199 |                 season_pricing = pricing.get('high_season', {}) or pricing.get('low_season', {})
1200 |

1202 |                 p_7_14 = season_pricing.get('price_7_14', 0)
1203 |                 p_15_29 = season_pricing.get('price_15_29', 0)
1204 |                 p_30 = season_pricing.get('price_30_plus', 0)
1205 |                 deposit = pricing.get('deposit', 5000)
1206 |                 
1207 |                 cars_context += (

1210 |                     f"Депозит: {deposit}฿\n"
1211 |                 )
1212 |                 
1213 |                 # Показываем всю галерею
1214 |                 photos = car.get('photos', {})
1215 |                 
1216 |                 # Main фото
1217 |                 main_photo = photos.get('main', '')
1218 |                 if main_photo:
1219 |                     cars_context += f"Главное фото: [image:{main_photo}]\n"
1220 |                 
1221 |                 # Вся галерея
1222 |                 gallery = photos.get('gallery', [])
1223 |                 if gallery and len(gallery) > 0:
1224 |                     gallery_paths = ', '.join([f"[image:{p}]" for p in gallery])
1225 |                     cars_context += f"Все фото: {gallery_paths}\n"
1226 |         
1227 |         # Системный промпт с инструкциями
1228 |         system_prompt = CLAUDE_SYSTEM_PROMPT + cars_context
1229 |         system_prompt += """
1230 | 
1231 | ПРАВИЛА ОТПРАВКИ ФОТО:

1234 | - Можешь отправить 2-6 фото одной машины если клиент просит
1235 | - НЕ отправляй все фото сразу без запроса
1236 | """
1237 |         
1238 |         # Определяем это первое сообщение или нет
1239 |         is_first_message = len(conversation_history) == 1

1241 |         
1242 |         # Вызов Claude

1257 |         except Exception as e:

1278 |

1281 |

1285 |

1301 |         # Сохраняем в историю

1713 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1714 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1715 |     try:
1716 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1717 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1718 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1719 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1720 | 
1721 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1722 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1723 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1724 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1725 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1726 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1727 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1728 |     except Exception as e:
1729 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1740 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1741 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1742 |     try:
1743 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1744 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1745 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1746 | 
1747 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1748 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1749 | 
1750 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1751 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1752 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1753 | 
1754 |         # Фильтрация
1755 |         filtered = []
1756 |         for u in users_data:
1757 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1758 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1759 |             
1760 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1761 |             
1762 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1763 |             
1764 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1765 |                 filtered.append(u)
1766 | 
1767 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1768 | 
1769 |         return {
1770 |             "status": "ok",
1771 |             "users": filtered
1772 |         }
1773 |     except Exception as e:
1774 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1775 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1780 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1781 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1782 |     try:
1783 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1784 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1785 |         
1786 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1787 |         if period == "today":
1788 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1789 |         elif period == "week":
1790 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1791 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1792 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1793 |         elif period == "month":
1794 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1795 |         else: # "all"
1796 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1797 | 
1798 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1799 |         stats = {
1800 |             "new": 0,
1801 |             "interested": 0,
1802 |             "pending": 0,
1803 |             "confirmed": 0,
1804 |             "completed": 0,
1805 |             "cancelled": 0,
1806 |             "no_response": 0,
1807 |             "archive": 0
1808 |         }
1809 | 
1810 |         for user in users_data:
1811 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1812 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1813 |             if not user_date_str:
1814 |                 continue
1815 |                 
1816 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1817 |             
1818 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1819 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1820 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1821 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1822 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1823 |                 else:
1824 |                     status = user.get("status")
1825 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1826 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1827 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1828 |                     
1829 |                     if status in stats:
1830 |                         stats[status] += 1
1831 | 
1832 |         return {
1833 |             "status": "ok",
1834 |             "period": period,
1835 |             "stats": stats
1836 |         }
1837 | 
1838 |     except Exception as e:
1839 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1840 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

 100 |   const getDaysCount = (start: any, end: any) => {
 101 |     if (!start || !end) return 0;
 102 |     const s = dayjs(start);
 103 |     const e = dayjs(end);
 104 |     const d = e.diff(s, 'day');
 105 |     return d <= 0 ? 1 : d;
 106 |   };

 108 |   const getFilteredUsers = (users: User[]): User[] => {
 109 |     return users.filter(user => {

 111 |

 113 |         return dialog?.has_new_messages;
 114 |       }
 115 |       if (dialogFilter === 'ai-on') {
 116 |         return dialog?.claude_status === 'active';
 117 |       }
 118 |       if (dialogFilter === 'ai-off') {
 119 |         return dialog?.active && dialog?.claude_status !== 'active';
 120 |       }
 121 |       return true;
 122 |     });

 125 |   const formatRelativeTime = (dateStr: string): string => {
 126 |     if (!dateStr) return '—';
 127 |     
 128 |     const now = dayjs();
 129 |     const date = dayjs(dateStr);
 130 |     const diffInMinutes = now.diff(date, 'minute');
 131 |     
 132 |     if (diffInMinutes < 1) return 'только что';
 133 |     if (diffInMinutes < 60) return `${diffInMinutes} мин назад`;
 134 |     
 135 |     const diffInHours = now.diff(date, 'hour');
 136 |     if (diffInHours < 24) return `${diffInHours} ч назад`;
 137 |     
 138 |     const diffInDays = now.diff(date, 'day');
 139 |     if (diffInDays < 7) return `${diffInDays} дн назад`;
 140 |     
 141 |     return date.format('DD.MM.YY');
 142 |   };

 163 | const fetchChatHistory = async (userId) => {
 164 |   try {
 165 |     const response = await fetch(`/api/crm/chats/${userId}`);
 166 |     const data = await response.json();
 167 |     if (data.status === 'ok' && data.chats) {
 168 |       // Добавляем проверку m !== null
 169 |       const uniqueChats = data.chats.filter((msg, index, self) => 
 170 |         msg && index === self.findIndex((m) => m && (
 171 |           (m.id && m.id === msg.id) || 
 172 |           (m.timestamp === msg.timestamp && (m.content === msg.content || m.text === msg?.text))
 173 |         ))
 174 |       );
 175 |       setChats(uniqueChats);
 176 |     }
 177 |   } catch (e) {
 178 |     console.error("Ошибка:", e);
 179 |   }
 180 | };

 320 |   const handleClaudeAction = async (userId: number, action: 'start' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'stop') => {
 321 |     setLoadingAction(prev => ({ ...prev, [`claude_${userId}_${action}`]: true }));
 322 |     try {
 323 |       const response = await fetch(`/api/claude/${action}`, {
 324 |         method: 'POST',
 325 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 326 |         body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: userId })
 327 |       });
 328 |       const result = await response.json();
 329 |       
 330 |       if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'ok') {
 331 |         if (action === 'start' || action === 'resume') {
 332 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 333 |             ...prev,
 334 |             [userId]: 'active'
 335 |           }));
 336 |         } else if (action === 'pause') {
 337 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 338 |             ...prev,
 339 |             [userId]: 'paused'
 340 |           }));
 341 |         } else if (action === 'stop') {
 342 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 343 |             ...prev,
 344 |             [userId]: 'stopped'
 345 |           }));
 346 |         }
 347 |         console.log(`✅ Claude ${action} для пользователя ${userId}:`, result.message || result);
 348 |         alert(`✅ Действие "${action}" выполнено успешно для пользователя ${userId}`);
 349 |       } else {
 350 |         console.error(`❌ Ошибка ${action} Claude:`, result.message || result);
 351 |         alert(`❌ Ошибка выполнения действия "${action}": ${result.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка'}`);
 352 |       }
 353 |     } catch (e) {
 354 |       console.error(`❌ Ошибка ${action} Claude:`, e);
 355 |       alert(`❌ Ошибка сети при выполнении действия "${action}"`);
 356 |     }
 357 |     finally {
 358 |       setLoadingAction(prev => ({ ...prev, [`claude_${userId}_${action}`]: false }));
 359 |     }
 360 |   };

### 1. **Отсутствующие endpoints в бэкенде**
Фронтенд пытается обращаться к несуществующим endpoints:
- `/api/crm/dialog/${userId}/status`

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default

 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):

 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)

 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 | 
 476 | def gen_booking_id() -> str:
 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")

 525 | def move_to_archive(user_id: int):
 526 |     """Переместить пользователя в архив"""
 527 |     try:
 528 |         print(f"🗂️ Moving user {user_id} to archive...")
 529 |         
 530 |         # Читаем user_data
 531 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 532 |             print(f"❌ USER_DATA_JSON not found: {USER_DATA_JSON}")
 533 |             return False
 534 |         
 535 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 536 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 537 |         
 538 |         print(f"📊 Total records in user_data: {len(users_data)}")
 539 |         
 540 |         # Находим все записи пользователя
 541 |         user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 542 |         if not user_records:
 543 |             print(f"❌ User {user_id} not found in user_data")
 544 |             return False
 545 |         
 546 |         print(f"📋 Found {len(user_records)} records for user {user_id}")
 547 |         
 548 |         # Читаем архив
 549 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 550 |             print(f"📁 Creating new archive file: {ARCHIVE_JSON}")
 551 |             archive_data = []
 552 |         else:
 553 |             with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 554 |                 archive_data = json.load(f)
 555 |         
 556 |         print(f"📊 Current archive size: {len(archive_data)} records")
 557 |         
 558 |         # Переносим в архив
 559 |         for record in user_records:
 560 |             record['archived_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 561 |             archive_data.append(record)
 562 |         
 563 |         # Удаляем из user_data
 564 |         users_data = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 565 |         
 566 |         # Сохраняем
 567 |         with _lock:
 568 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 569 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 570 |         
 571 |         print(f"✅ Moved user {user_id} to archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 572 |         print(f"📊 New user_data size: {len(users_data)}")
 573 |         print(f"📊 New archive size: {len(archive_data)}")
 574 |         
 575 |         return True
 576 |         
 577 |     except Exception as e:
 578 |         print(f"❌ Error moving to archive: {e}")
 579 |         import traceback
 580 |         traceback.print_exc()
 581 |         return False

 597 |

 603 |         for record in user_records:
 604 |             record['final_status'] = 'in_progress'
 605 |             record['restored_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 606 |             if 'archived_at' in record:
 607 |                 del record['archived_at']
 608 |             users_data.append(record)

 610 |         # Удаляем из архива

 612 |         
 613 |         # Сохраняем
 614 |         with _lock:
 615 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 616 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 617 |         
 618 |         print(f"✅ Restored user {user_id} from archive ({len(user_records)} records)")

 620 |         
 621 |     except Exception as e:
