1713 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1714 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1715 |     try:
1716 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1717 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1718 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1719 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1720 | 
1721 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1722 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1723 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1724 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1725 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1726 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1727 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1728 |     except Exception as e:
1729 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1740 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1741 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1742 |     try:
1743 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1744 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1745 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1746 | 
1747 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1748 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1749 | 
1750 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1751 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1752 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1753 | 
1754 |         # Фильтрация
1755 |         filtered = []
1756 |         for u in users_data:
1757 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1758 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1759 |             
1760 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1761 |             
1762 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1763 |             
1764 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1765 |                 filtered.append(u)
1766 | 
1767 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1768 | 
1769 |         return {
1770 |             "status": "ok",
1771 |             "users": filtered
1772 |         }
1773 |     except Exception as e:
1774 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1775 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1780 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1781 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1782 |     try:
1783 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1784 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1785 |         
1786 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1787 |         if period == "today":
1788 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1789 |         elif period == "week":
1790 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1791 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1792 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1793 |         elif period == "month":
1794 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1795 |         else: # "all"
1796 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1797 | 
1798 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1799 |         stats = {
1800 |             "new": 0,
1801 |             "interested": 0,
1802 |             "pending": 0,
1803 |             "confirmed": 0,
1804 |             "completed": 0,
1805 |             "cancelled": 0,
1806 |             "no_response": 0,
1807 |             "archive": 0
1808 |         }
1809 | 
1810 |         for user in users_data:
1811 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1812 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1813 |             if not user_date_str:
1814 |                 continue
1815 |                 
1816 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1817 |             
1818 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1819 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1820 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1821 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1822 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1823 |                 else:
1824 |                     status = user.get("status")
1825 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1826 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1827 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1828 |                     
1829 |                     if status in stats:
1830 |                         stats[status] += 1
1831 | 
1832 |         return {
1833 |             "status": "ok",
1834 |             "period": period,
1835 |             "stats": stats
1836 |         }
1837 | 
1838 |     except Exception as e:
1839 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1840 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2488 | @app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/send_message")
2489 | async def send_message_to_user(msg_request: SendMessageRequest):
2490 |     """Отправить сообщение пользователю через Telegram бота"""
2491 |     try:
2492 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2493 |         
2494 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2495 |         try:
2496 |             chat_log_entry = {
2497 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2498 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2499 |                 "role": "manager",
2500 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2501 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2502 |             }
2503 |             
2504 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2505 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2506 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2507 |         except Exception as log_error:
2508 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2509 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2510 |         
2511 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2512 |         update_dialog_status(
2513 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2514 |             active=True,
2515 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2516 |             last_message_from="manager",
2517 |             message_count_increment=1
2518 |         )
2519 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2520 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2521 |         )
2522 |         
2523 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2524 |         try:
2525 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2526 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2527 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2528 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2529 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2530 |             
2531 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2532 |             
2533 |             response = requests.post(
2534 |                 internal_endpoint,
2535 |                 json={
2536 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2537 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2538 |                 },
2539 |                 timeout=10,
2540 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2541 |             )
2542 |             
2543 |             if response.status_code == 200:
2544 |                 result = response.json()
2545 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2546 |                 return {
2547 |                     "status": "ok",
2548 |                     "message": "Message sent successfully",
2549 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2550 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2551 |                 }
2552 |             else:
2553 |                 print(f"⚠️ Bot returned status {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
2554 |                 return {
2555 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2556 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2557 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2558 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2559 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2560 |                 }
2561 |                 
2562 |         except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
2563 |             print(f"⚠️ Error connecting to bot: {e}")
2564 |             return {
2565 |                 "status": "partial_success",
2566 |                 "message": "Message logged but bot unreachable",
2567 |                 "logged_to_history": True,
2568 |                 "sent_via_bot": False,
2569 |                 "bot_error": str(e)
2570 |             }
2571 |             
2572 |     except Exception as e:
2573 |         print(f"❌ Error in send_message: {e}")
2574 |         import traceback
2575 |         traceback.print_exc()
2576 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2582 |     try:

2585 |         text = data.get('text')
2586 |         username = data.get('username')
2587 |         timestamp = data.get('timestamp')
2588 |         
2589 |         if not user_id or not text:
2590 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and text are required")
2591 |         
2592 |         print(f"📨 Received message from bot: user {user_id}, text: {text[:50]}...")
2593 |         
2594 |         # 1. Log message to chat history with role "user"
2595 |         try:
2596 |             chat_log_entry = {
2597 |                 "timestamp": timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2598 |                 "user_id": user_id,
2599 |                 "role": "user",
2600 |                 "text": text,
2601 |                 "username": username,
2602 |                 "source": "telegram_bot"
2603 |             }
2604 |             
2605 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2606 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2607 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {user_id}")
2608 |         except Exception as log_error:
2609 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2610 |         
2611 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: новое сообщение от пользователя
2612 |         update_dialog_status(
2613 |             user_id=user_id,
2614 |             active=True,
2615 |             has_new_messages=True,
2616 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2617 |             last_message_from="user",
2618 |             message_count_increment=1,
2619 |             username=username
2620 |         )
2621 |         log_dialog_event(user_id,action="receive_message_from_bot",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
2622 |         
2623 |         # 3. Update user metadata (last message time) to move them up in CRM chat list
2624 |         try:
2625 |             users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
2626 |             user_updated = False
2627 |             
2628 |             for user in users_data:
2629 |                 if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
2630 |                     user['last_message_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2631 |                     user['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2632 |                     user_updated = True
2633 |                     break
2634 |             
2635 |             if user_updated:
2636 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2637 |                 print(f"✅ Updated metadata for user {user_id}")
2638 |             else:
2639 |                 print(f"⚠️ User {user_id} not found in user_data, creating new record")
2640 |                 # Create new user record if not exists
2641 |                 new_user = {
2642 |                     "user_id": user_id,
2643 |                     "username": username,
2644 |                     "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2645 |                     "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2646 |                     "status": "new",
2647 |                     "form_started": False,
2648 |                     "booking_submitted": False,
2649 |                     "car_interested": None,
2650 |                     "category_interested": None,
2651 |                     "dates_selected": None,
2652 |                     "notes": [],
2653 |                     "source": "telegram_bot",
2654 |                     "last_message_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2655 |                 }
2656 |                 users_data.append(new_user)
2657 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2658 |                 print(f"✅ Created new user record for {user_id}")
2659 |                 
2660 |         except Exception as metadata_error:
2661 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to update user metadata: {metadata_error}")
2662 |         
2663 |         return {
2664 |             "status": "ok",
2665 |             "message": "Message received and logged successfully"
2666 |         }
2667 |         
2668 |     except Exception as e:
2669 |         print(f"❌ Error in receive_message_from_bot: {e}")
2670 |         import traceback
2671 |         traceback.print_exc()
2672 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2907 |     try:

2913 |             # Сначала проверить, не связан ли этот автомобиль с другим владельцем
2914 |             for owner_id, owner in owners.items():
2915 |                 if car_id in owner.get("car_ids", {}):
2916 |                     # Удалить автомобиль из предыдущего владельца
2917 |                     del owner["car_ids"][car_id]
2918 |                     owner["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2919 |             
2920 |             # Добавить автомобиль к новому владельцу
2921 |             if owner_info.owner_id not in owners:
2922 |                 raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Owner with ID '{owner_info.owner_id}' not found")
2923 |

2928 |                     "status": "available",
2929 |                     "available_until": None,
2930 |                     "facebook_url": None,
2931 |                     "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2932 |                 }
2933 |         
2934 |         # Найти владельца текущего автомобиля для обновления его данных
2935 |         current_owner = None
2936 |         current_owner_id = None
2937 |         for owner_id, owner in owners.items():
2938 |             if car_id in owner.get("car_ids", {}):
2939 |                 current_owner = owner
2940 |                 current_owner_id = owner_id
2941 |                 break
2942 |         
2943 |         if not current_owner:
2944 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Car '{car_id}' not found in any owner's inventory")
2945 |         
2946 |         car_data = current_owner["car_ids"][car_id]
2947 |         
2948 |         # Обновить статус если указан
2949 |         if owner_info.status is not None:
2950 |             car_data["status"] = owner_info.status
2951 |         
2952 |         # Обновить Facebook URL если указан

2955 |         
2956 |         # Обновить дату если указана

2959 |         
2960 |         # Обновить пометки если указаны
2961 |         if owner_info.notes is not None:
2962 |             car_data["notes"] = owner_info.notes
2963 |         
2964 |         car_data["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2965 |         current_owner["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2966 |         
2967 |         with _lock:

2969 |         
2970 |         return {

3013 |

3039 |             )
3040 |         
3041 |         # Конвертируем Pydantic в dict

3043 |         
3044 |         bookings = load_bookings()
3045 |         
3046 |         if booking_id:

3049 |             found = False
3050 |             for booking in bookings:

3053 |                     booking['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
3054 |                     found = True

3056 |                     break

3066 |             bookings.append({

3068 |                 "user_id": "admin",

3073 |             })

3075 |

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default

 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):
 435 |     tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
 436 |     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)

 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 | 
 476 | def gen_booking_id() -> str:
 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")

 626 | def auto_archive_old_records():
 627 |     """Автоматическая архивация старых записей"""
 628 |     try:
 629 |         from datetime import timedelta
 630 |         
 631 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 632 |             return {"archived": 0, "errors": 0}
 633 |         
 634 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 635 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 636 |         
 637 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
 638 |         to_archive = []
 639 |         
 640 |         # Правила архивации
 641 |         for user in users_data:
 642 |             timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 643 |             try:
 644 |                 user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 645 |             except:
 646 |                 continue
 647 |             
 648 |             age_days = (now - user_time).days
 649 |             status = user.get('final_status', '')
 650 |             
 651 |             # Правила:
 652 |             should_archive = False
 653 |             
 654 |             if status == 'new' and age_days > 14:
 655 |                 should_archive = True  # Новые > 2 недели
 656 |             elif status == 'awaiting_followup' and age_days > 30:
 657 |                 should_archive = True  # Теплые > 1 месяц
 658 |             elif status in ['rejected', 'new']:
 659 |                 should_archive = True  # Отказы и холодные сразу
 660 |             elif status == 'completed':
 661 |                 should_archive = True  # Завершенные сразу
 662 |             
 663 |             if should_archive:
 664 |                 to_archive.append(user.get('user_id'))
 665 |         
 666 |         # Архивируем
 667 |         archived_count = 0
 668 |         for user_id in set(to_archive):  # unique user_ids
 669 |             if move_to_archive(user_id):
 670 |                 archived_count += 1
 671 |         
 672 |         print(f"✅ Auto-archived {archived_count} users")
 673 |         return {"archived": archived_count, "errors": 0}
 674 |         
 675 |     except Exception as e:
 676 |         print(f"❌ Error in auto_archive: {e}")
 677 |         return {"archived": 0, "errors": 1}

 680 | def filter_by_period(users_data: list, period: str) -> list:
 681 |     """Фильтровать записи по периоду"""
 682 |     from datetime import timedelta
 683 |     
 684 |     if period == 'all':
 685 |         return users_data
 686 |     
 687 |     now = datetime.utcnow()
 688 |     
 689 |     # Определяем период
 690 |     if period == 'today':
 691 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=1)
 692 |     elif period == 'week':
 693 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
 694 |     elif period == '2weeks':
 695 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=14)
 696 |     elif period == 'month':
 697 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
 698 |     else:
 699 |         return users_data
 700 |     
 701 |     # Фильтруем
 702 |     filtered = []
 703 |     for user in users_data:
 704 |         timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 705 |         try:
 706 |             user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 707 |             if user_time >= cutoff:
 708 |                 filtered.append(user)
 709 |         except:
 710 |             continue
 711 |     
 712 |     return filtered

 714 | def determine_category(car_name: str) -> str:

 716 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['yaris', 'ativ', 'city', 'mazda2', 'mg5']):
 717 |         return 'compact'
 718 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['civic', 'altis', 'camry', 'corolla']):
 719 |         return 'sedan'
 720 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['hrv', 'cx3', 'cx30', 'fortuner', 'xforce', 'mux']):
 721 |         return 'suv'
 722 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['xpander', 'veloz']):
 723 |         return '7s'
 724 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['pcx', 'click', 'bike', 'скутер', 'мото']):
 725 |         return 'bikes'
 726 |     return 'sedan'

 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

1078 | def initiate_claude_dialogue(user_id, user_filters=None):
1079 |     """Запускает диалог Claude с подбором машин"""
1080 |     print(f"🤖 Initiating Claude dialogue for user {user_id}")
1081 |     
1082 |     if user_id in user_conversations and user_conversations[user_id].get("status") == "active":
1083 |         print(f"Dialogue with user {user_id} is already active.")
1084 |         return {"status": "already_active", "message": "Диалог уже активен"}
1085 |     
1086 |     if user_id in user_sessions and user_sessions[user_id].get("claude_initiated"):
1087 |         print(f"Claude already initiated for user {user_id}.")
1088 |         return {"status": "already_initiated", "message": "Claude уже был инициализирован"}

1114 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):

1165 |     except Exception as e:

1167 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1563 |     """Track user events - ONE record per user"""
1564 |     try:
1565 |         user_id = int(request.user_id)
1566 |         event_type = request.event_type
1567 |         event_data = request.data or {}
1568 |         username = request.username
1569 | 
1570 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1571 |         bookings = load_bookings()
1572 | 
1573 |         # Найти существующего пользователя
1574 |         user_index = next((i for i, u in enumerate(users_data) if u.get("user_id") == user_id), None)
1575 |         
1576 |         if user_index is not None:
1577 |             user_record = users_data[user_index]
1578 |             # Обновляем username если он изменился
1579 |             if username and username != user_record.get("username"):
1580 |                 user_record["username"] = username
1581 |         else:
1582 |             # Создаем нового пользователя
1583 |             user_record = {

1713 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1714 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1715 |     try:
1716 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1717 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1718 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1719 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1720 | 
1721 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1722 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1723 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1724 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1725 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1726 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1727 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1728 |     except Exception as e:
1729 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1740 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1741 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1742 |     try:
1743 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1744 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1745 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1746 | 
1747 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1748 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1749 | 
1750 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1751 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1752 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1753 | 
1754 |         # Фильтрация
1755 |         filtered = []
1756 |         for u in users_data:
1757 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1758 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1759 |             
1760 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1761 |             
1762 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1763 |             
1764 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1765 |                 filtered.append(u)
1766 | 
1767 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1768 | 
1769 |         return {
1770 |             "status": "ok",
1771 |             "users": filtered
1772 |         }
1773 |     except Exception as e:
1774 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1775 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1780 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1781 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1782 |     try:
1783 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1784 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1785 |         
1786 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1787 |         if period == "today":
1788 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1789 |         elif period == "week":
1790 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1791 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1792 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1793 |         elif period == "month":
1794 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1795 |         else: # "all"
1796 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1797 | 
1798 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1799 |         stats = {
1800 |             "new": 0,
1801 |             "interested": 0,
1802 |             "pending": 0,
1803 |             "confirmed": 0,
1804 |             "completed": 0,
1805 |             "cancelled": 0,
1806 |             "no_response": 0,
1807 |             "archive": 0
1808 |         }
1809 | 
1810 |         for user in users_data:
1811 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1812 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1813 |             if not user_date_str:
1814 |                 continue
1815 |                 
1816 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1817 |             
1818 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1819 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1820 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1821 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1822 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1823 |                 else:
1824 |                     status = user.get("status")
1825 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1826 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1827 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1828 |                     
1829 |                     if status in stats:
1830 |                         stats[status] += 1
1831 | 
1832 |         return {
1833 |             "status": "ok",
1834 |             "period": period,
1835 |             "stats": stats
1836 |         }
1837 | 
1838 |     except Exception as e:
1839 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1840 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

1980 |

1990 |             elif period == 'month':
1991 |                 cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
1992 |             else:

1994 |

2002 |                 except:

2010 |             "status": "ok",

2488 | @app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/send_message")
2489 | async def send_message_to_user(msg_request: SendMessageRequest):
2490 |     """Отправить сообщение пользователю через Telegram бота"""
2491 |     try:
2492 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2493 |         
2494 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2495 |         try:
2496 |             chat_log_entry = {
2497 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2498 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2499 |                 "role": "manager",
2500 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2501 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2502 |             }
2503 |             
2504 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2505 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2506 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2507 |         except Exception as log_error:
2508 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2509 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2510 |         
2511 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2512 |         update_dialog_status(
2513 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2514 |             active=True,
2515 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2516 |             last_message_from="manager",
2517 |             message_count_increment=1
2518 |         )
2519 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2520 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2521 |         )
2522 |         
2523 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2524 |         try:
2525 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2526 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2527 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2528 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2529 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2530 |             
2531 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2532 |             
2533 |             response = requests.post(
2534 |                 internal_endpoint,
2535 |                 json={
2536 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2537 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2538 |                 },
2539 |                 timeout=10,
2540 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2541 |             )
2542 |             
2543 |             if response.status_code == 200:
2544 |                 result = response.json()
2545 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2546 |                 return {
2547 |                     "status": "ok",
2548 |                     "message": "Message sent successfully",
2549 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2550 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2551 |                 }
2552 |             else:
2553 |                 print(f"⚠️ Bot returned status {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
2554 |                 return {
2555 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2556 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2557 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2558 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2559 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2560 |                 }
2561 |                 
2562 |         except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
2563 |             print(f"⚠️ Error connecting to bot: {e}")
2564 |             return {
2565 |                 "status": "partial_success",
2566 |                 "message": "Message logged but bot unreachable",
2567 |                 "logged_to_history": True,
2568 |                 "sent_via_bot": False,
2569 |                 "bot_error": str(e)
2570 |             }
2571 |             
2572 |     except Exception as e:
2573 |         print(f"❌ Error in send_message: {e}")
2574 |         import traceback
2575 |         traceback.print_exc()
2576 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2616 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2617 |             last_message_from="user",
2618 |             message_count_increment=1,

2620 |         )
2621 |         log_dialog_event(user_id,action="receive_message_from_bot",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
2622 |

# --- КЛОД (УПРАВЛЕНИЕ ДИАЛОГОМ) ---

@app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/start-claude")
def start_claude(req: StartClaudeRequest):
    """Запустить Claude диалог для пользователя"""
    try:
        user_id = req.user_id
        print(f"🚀 Starting Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: START
        update_dialog_status(
            user_id=user_id,
            claude_enabled=True,
            claude_status="active",
            claude_started_at=datetime.now().isoformat()
        )
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_started", timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat())
        
        return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Claude started for user {user_id}"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in start_claude: {e}")
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

@app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/pause-claude")
def pause_claude(req: StartClaudeRequest):
    """Приостановить Claude диалог"""
    try:
        user_id = req.user_id
        print(f"⏸️ Pausing Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: PAUSE
        update_dialog_status(
            user_id=user_id,
            claude_enabled=False,
            claude_status="paused",
            claude_paused_at=datetime.now().isoformat()
        )
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_paused",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Claude paused for user {user_id}"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in pause_claude: {e}")
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

@app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/resume-claude")
def resume_claude(req: StartClaudeRequest):
    """Возобновить Claude диалог"""
    try:
        user_id = req.user_id
        print(f"▶️ Resuming Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: RESUME
        update_dialog_status(
            user_id=user_id,
            claude_enabled=True,
            claude_status="active"
        )
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_resumed",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Claude resumed for user {user_id}"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in resume_claude: {e}")
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

@app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stop-claude")
def stop_claude(req: StartClaudeRequest):
    """Остановить Claude диалог"""
    try:
        user_id = req.user_id
        print(f"⏹️ Stopping Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: STOP
        update_dialog_status(
            user_id=user_id,
            active=False,
            claude_enabled=False,
            claude_status="stopped"
        )
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_stopped",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Claude stopped for user {user_id}"}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in stop_claude: {e}")
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

class SendMessageRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: int
    text: str
    role: str = "manager"
    timestamp: str

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default
 433 | 
 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):
 435 |     tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
 436 |     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)
 439 | 
 440 | def as_cars_list(data: Any) -> List[Dict]:
 441 |     if isinstance(data, dict) and "cars" in data:
 442 |         return list(data["cars"].values())
 443 |     if isinstance(data, list):
 444 |         return data
 445 |     if isinstance(data, dict):
 446 |         return list(data.values())
 447 |     return []

 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 | 
 476 | def gen_booking_id() -> str:
 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
 478 |

 493 | def get_user_latest_record(user_id: int, from_archive: bool = False):
 494 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if from_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 495 |     users_data = load_json(json_file)
 496 |     user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 497 |     if not user_records:
 498 |         return None
 499 |     user_records.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('timestamp', ''), reverse=True)
 500 |     return user_records[0]

 502 | def update_all_user_records(user_id: int, updates: dict, in_archive: bool = False):
 503 |     """Обновить все записи пользователя"""
 504 |     json_file = ARCHIVE_JSON if in_archive else USER_DATA_JSON
 505 |     
 506 |     if not json_file.exists():
 507 |         return False
 508 |     
 509 |     with open(json_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 510 |         users_data = json.load(f)
 511 |     
 512 |     updated = False
 513 |     for user in users_data:
 514 |         if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
 515 |             user.update(updates)
 516 |             updated = True
 517 |     
 518 |     if updated:
 519 |         with _lock:
 520 |             save_json(json_file, users_data)
 521 |     
 522 |     return updated

 525 | def move_to_archive(user_id: int):
 526 |     """Переместить пользователя в архив"""
 527 |     try:
 528 |         print(f"🗂️ Moving user {user_id} to archive...")
 529 |         
 530 |         # Читаем user_data
 531 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 532 |             print(f"❌ USER_DATA_JSON not found: {USER_DATA_JSON}")
 533 |             return False
 534 |         
 535 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 536 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 537 |         
 538 |         print(f"📊 Total records in user_data: {len(users_data)}")
 539 |         
 540 |         # Находим все записи пользователя
 541 |         user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 542 |         if not user_records:
 543 |             print(f"❌ User {user_id} not found in user_data")
 544 |             return False
 545 |         
 546 |         print(f"📋 Found {len(user_records)} records for user {user_id}")
 547 |         
 548 |         # Читаем архив
 549 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 550 |             print(f"📁 Creating new archive file: {ARCHIVE_JSON}")
 551 |             archive_data = []
 552 |         else:
 553 |             with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 554 |                 archive_data = json.load(f)
 555 |         
 556 |         print(f"📊 Current archive size: {len(archive_data)} records")
 557 |         
 558 |         # Переносим в архив
 559 |         for record in user_records:
 560 |             record['archived_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 561 |             archive_data.append(record)
 562 |         
 563 |         # Удаляем из user_data
 564 |         users_data = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 565 |         
 566 |         # Сохраняем
 567 |         with _lock:
 568 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 569 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 570 |         
 571 |         print(f"✅ Moved user {user_id} to archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 572 |         print(f"📊 New user_data size: {len(users_data)}")
 573 |         print(f"📊 New archive size: {len(archive_data)}")
 574 |         
 575 |         return True
 576 |         
 577 |     except Exception as e:
 578 |         print(f"❌ Error moving to archive: {e}")
 579 |         import traceback
 580 |         traceback.print_exc()
 581 |         return False

 583 | def restore_from_archive(user_id: int):
 584 |     """Восстановить пользователя из архива"""
 585 |     try:
 586 |         # Читаем архив
 587 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 588 |             return False
 589 |

 597 |

 626 | def auto_archive_old_records():
 627 |     """Автоматическая архивация старых записей"""
 628 |     try:
 629 |         from datetime import timedelta
 630 |         
 631 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 632 |             return {"archived": 0, "errors": 0}
 633 |         
 634 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 635 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 636 |         
 637 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
 638 |         to_archive = []
 639 |         
 640 |         # Правила архивации
 641 |         for user in users_data:
 642 |             timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 643 |             try:
 644 |                 user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 645 |             except:
 646 |                 continue
 647 |             
 648 |             age_days = (now - user_time).days
 649 |             status = user.get('final_status', '')
 650 |             
 651 |             # Правила:
 652 |             should_archive = False
 653 |             
 654 |             if status == 'new' and age_days > 14:
 655 |                 should_archive = True  # Новые > 2 недели
 656 |             elif status == 'awaiting_followup' and age_days > 30:
 657 |                 should_archive = True  # Теплые > 1 месяц
 658 |             elif status in ['rejected', 'new']:
 659 |                 should_archive = True  # Отказы и холодные сразу
 660 |             elif status == 'completed':
 661 |                 should_archive = True  # Завершенные сразу
 662 |             
 663 |             if should_archive:
 664 |                 to_archive.append(user.get('user_id'))
 665 |         
 666 |         # Архивируем
 667 |         archived_count = 0
 668 |         for user_id in set(to_archive):  # unique user_ids
 669 |             if move_to_archive(user_id):
 670 |                 archived_count += 1
 671 |         
 672 |         print(f"✅ Auto-archived {archived_count} users")
 673 |         return {"archived": archived_count, "errors": 0}
 674 |         
 675 |     except Exception as e:
 676 |         print(f"❌ Error in auto_archive: {e}")
 677 |         return {"archived": 0, "errors": 1}

 680 | def filter_by_period(users_data: list, period: str) -> list:
 681 |     """Фильтровать записи по периоду"""
 682 |     from datetime import timedelta
 683 |     
 684 |     if period == 'all':
 685 |         return users_data
 686 |     
 687 |     now = datetime.utcnow()
 688 |     
 689 |     # Определяем период
 690 |     if period == 'today':
 691 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=1)
 692 |     elif period == 'week':
 693 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
 694 |     elif period == '2weeks':
 695 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=14)
 696 |     elif period == 'month':
 697 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
 698 |     else:
 699 |         return users_data
 700 |     
 701 |     # Фильтруем
 702 |     filtered = []
 703 |     for user in users_data:
 704 |         timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 705 |         try:
 706 |             user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 707 |             if user_time >= cutoff:
 708 |                 filtered.append(user)
 709 |         except:
 710 |             continue
 711 |     
 712 |     return filtered

 714 | def determine_category(car_name: str) -> str:

 716 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['yaris', 'ativ', 'city', 'mazda2', 'mg5']):
 717 |         return 'compact'
 718 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['civic', 'altis', 'camry', 'corolla']):

 722 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['xpander', 'veloz']):
 723 |         return '7s'
 724 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['pcx', 'click', 'bike', 'скутер', 'мото']):
 725 |         return 'bikes'
 726 |     return 'sedan'

 820 |         
 821 |         if "has_new_messages" in kwargs:

 823 |         
 824 |         if "last_message_at" in kwargs:

 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

1078 | def initiate_claude_dialogue(user_id, user_filters=None):
1079 |     """Запускает диалог Claude с подбором машин"""
1080 |     print(f"🤖 Initiating Claude dialogue for user {user_id}")
1081 |     
1082 |     if user_id in user_conversations and user_conversations[user_id].get("status") == "active":
1083 |         print(f"Dialogue with user {user_id} is already active.")
1084 |         return {"status": "already_active", "message": "Диалог уже активен"}
1085 |     
1086 |     if user_id in user_sessions and user_sessions[user_id].get("claude_initiated"):
1087 |         print(f"Claude already initiated for user {user_id}.")
1088 |         return {"status": "already_initiated", "message": "Claude уже был инициализирован"}
1089 |     
1090 |     try:
1091 |         # Активируем диалог сразу
1092 |         user_conversations[user_id] = {
1093 |             "status": "active",
1094 |             "history": [],
1095 |             "filters": user_filters or {}
1096 |         }
1097 |         
1098 |         if user_id not in user_sessions:
1099 |             user_sessions[user_id] = {}
1100 |         user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
1101 | 
1102 |         # Сразу запускаем подбор вариантов
1103 |         handle_claude_best_options(user_id)
1104 |         
1105 |         print(f"✅ Claude dialogue initiated for user {user_id}")
1106 |         return {"status": "success", "message": "Диалог Claude запущен"}
1107 |         
1108 |     except Exception as e:
1109 |         print(f"❌ Failed to initiate dialogue with user {user_id}: {e}")
1110 |         import traceback
1111 |         traceback.print_exc()
1112 |         return {"status": "error", "message": f"Ошибка запуска диалога: {str(e)}"}
1113 | 
1114 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):
1115 |     """Claude генерирует текст и отправляет его на внутренний эндпоинт для доставки юзеру"""
1116 |     try:
1117 |         # 1. Получаем данные из диалогов (как и раньше)
1118 |         if user_id not in user_conversations:
1119 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден"}
1120 |         
1121 |         user_filters = user_conversations[user_id].get("filters") or {}
1122 |         days = user_filters.get('days', '')
1123 |         start_date = user_filters.get('start_date', '')
1124 |         end_date = user_filters.get('end_date', '')

1211 |                 )
1212 |                 
1213 |                 # Показываем всю галерею
1214 |                 photos = car.get('photos', {})

1216 |                 # Main фото

1218 |                 if main_photo:
1219 |                     cars_context += f"Главное фото: [image:{main_photo}]\n"

1226 |

1229 |         system_prompt += """

1235 | - НЕ отправляй все фото сразу без запроса
1236 | """
1237 |

1713 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1714 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1715 |     try:
1716 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1717 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1718 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1719 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1720 | 
1721 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1722 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1723 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1724 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1725 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1726 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1727 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1728 |     except Exception as e:
1729 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1740 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1741 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1742 |     try:
1743 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1744 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1745 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1746 | 
1747 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1748 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1749 | 
1750 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1751 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1752 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1753 | 
1754 |         # Фильтрация
1755 |         filtered = []
1756 |         for u in users_data:
1757 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1758 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1759 |             
1760 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1761 |             
1762 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1763 |             
1764 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1765 |                 filtered.append(u)
1766 | 
1767 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1768 | 
1769 |         return {
1770 |             "status": "ok",
1771 |             "users": filtered
1772 |         }
1773 |     except Exception as e:
1774 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1775 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1780 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1781 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1782 |     try:
1783 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1784 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1785 |         
1786 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1787 |         if period == "today":
1788 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1789 |         elif period == "week":
1790 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
1791 |         elif period == "2weeks":
1792 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
1793 |         elif period == "month":
1794 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
1795 |         else: # "all"
1796 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
1797 | 
1798 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
1799 |         stats = {
1800 |             "new": 0,
1801 |             "interested": 0,
1802 |             "pending": 0,
1803 |             "confirmed": 0,
1804 |             "completed": 0,
1805 |             "cancelled": 0,
1806 |             "no_response": 0,
1807 |             "archive": 0
1808 |         }
1809 | 
1810 |         for user in users_data:
1811 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
1812 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
1813 |             if not user_date_str:
1814 |                 continue
1815 |                 
1816 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
1817 |             
1818 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
1819 |             if user_date >= start_date:
1820 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
1821 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
1822 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
1823 |                 else:
1824 |                     status = user.get("status")
1825 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
1826 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
1827 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
1828 |                     
1829 |                     if status in stats:
1830 |                         stats[status] += 1
1831 | 
1832 |         return {
1833 |             "status": "ok",
1834 |             "period": period,
1835 |             "stats": stats
1836 |         }
1837 | 
1838 |     except Exception as e:
1839 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
1840 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2488 | @app.post(API_PREFIX + "/crm/send_message")
2489 | async def send_message_to_user(msg_request: SendMessageRequest):
2490 |     """Отправить сообщение пользователю через Telegram бота"""
2491 |     try:
2492 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2493 |         
2494 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2495 |         try:
2496 |             chat_log_entry = {
2497 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2498 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2499 |                 "role": "manager",
2500 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2501 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2502 |             }
2503 |             
2504 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2505 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2506 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2507 |         except Exception as log_error:
2508 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2509 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2510 |         
2511 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2512 |         update_dialog_status(
2513 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2514 |             active=True,
2515 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2516 |             last_message_from="manager",
2517 |             message_count_increment=1
2518 |         )
2519 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2520 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2521 |         )
2522 |         
2523 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2524 |         try:
2525 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2526 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2527 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2528 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2529 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2530 |             
2531 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2532 |             
2533 |             response = requests.post(
2534 |                 internal_endpoint,
2535 |                 json={
2536 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2537 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2538 |                 },
2539 |                 timeout=10,
2540 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2541 |             )
2542 |             
2543 |             if response.status_code == 200:
2544 |                 result = response.json()
2545 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2546 |                 return {
2547 |                     "status": "ok",
2548 |                     "message": "Message sent successfully",
2549 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2550 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2551 |                 }
2552 |             else:
2553 |                 print(f"⚠️ Bot returned status {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
2554 |                 return {
2555 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2556 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2557 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2558 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2559 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2560 |                 }
2561 |                 
2562 |         except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
2563 |             print(f"⚠️ Error connecting to bot: {e}")
2564 |             return {
2565 |                 "status": "partial_success",
2566 |                 "message": "Message logged but bot unreachable",
2567 |                 "logged_to_history": True,
2568 |                 "sent_via_bot": False,
2569 |                 "bot_error": str(e)
2570 |             }
2571 |             
2572 |     except Exception as e:
2573 |         print(f"❌ Error in send_message: {e}")
2574 |         import traceback
2575 |         traceback.print_exc()
2576 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2579 | @app.post("/api/internal/receive-message")
2580 | async def receive_message_from_bot(request: Request):
2581 |     """Receive message from Telegram bot and log it"""
2582 |     try:
2583 |         data = await request.json()
2584 |         user_id = data.get('user_id')
2585 |         text = data.get('text')
2586 |         username = data.get('username')
2587 |         timestamp = data.get('timestamp')
2588 |         
2589 |         if not user_id or not text:
2590 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and text are required")
2591 |         
2592 |         print(f"📨 Received message from bot: user {user_id}, text: {text[:50]}...")
2593 |         
2594 |         # 1. Log message to chat history with role "user"
2595 |         try:
2596 |             chat_log_entry = {
2597 |                 "timestamp": timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2598 |                 "user_id": user_id,
2599 |                 "role": "user",
2600 |                 "text": text,
2601 |                 "username": username,
2602 |                 "source": "telegram_bot"
2603 |             }
2604 |             
2605 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2606 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2607 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {user_id}")
2608 |         except Exception as log_error:
2609 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2610 |         
2611 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: новое сообщение от пользователя
2612 |         update_dialog_status(
2613 |             user_id=user_id,
2614 |             active=True,
2615 |             has_new_messages=True,
2616 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2617 |             last_message_from="user",
2618 |             message_count_increment=1,
2619 |             username=username
2620 |         )
2621 |         log_dialog_event(user_id,action="receive_message_from_bot",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
2622 |         
2623 |         # 3. Update user metadata (last message time) to move them up in CRM chat list
2624 |         try:
2625 |             users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
2626 |             user_updated = False
2627 |             
2628 |             for user in users_data:
2629 |                 if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
2630 |                     user['last_message_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2631 |                     user['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2632 |                     user_updated = True
2633 |                     break
2634 |             
2635 |             if user_updated:
2636 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2637 |                 print(f"✅ Updated metadata for user {user_id}")
2638 |             else:
2639 |                 print(f"⚠️ User {user_id} not found in user_data, creating new record")
2640 |                 # Create new user record if not exists
2641 |                 new_user = {
2642 |                     "user_id": user_id,
2643 |                     "username": username,
2644 |                     "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2645 |                     "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2646 |                     "status": "new",
2647 |                     "form_started": False,
2648 |                     "booking_submitted": False,
2649 |                     "car_interested": None,
2650 |                     "category_interested": None,
2651 |                     "dates_selected": None,
2652 |                     "notes": [],
2653 |                     "source": "telegram_bot",
2654 |                     "last_message_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2655 |                 }
2656 |                 users_data.append(new_user)
2657 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2658 |                 print(f"✅ Created new user record for {user_id}")
2659 |                 
2660 |         except Exception as metadata_error:
2661 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to update user metadata: {metadata_error}")
2662 |         
2663 |         return {
2664 |             "status": "ok",
2665 |             "message": "Message received and logged successfully"
2666 |         }
2667 |         
2668 |     except Exception as e:
2669 |         print(f"❌ Error in receive_message_from_bot: {e}")
2670 |         import traceback
2671 |         traceback.print_exc()
2672 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2907 |     try:

2913 |             # Сначала проверить, не связан ли этот автомобиль с другим владельцем
