 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

 994 | def get_dialog_events(user_id: int, limit: int = 50):
 995 |     """
 996 |     Получает историю событий диалога пользователя
 997 |     """
 998 |     try:
 999 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
1000 |         events = []
1001 |

1003 |         if history_file.exists():
1004 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

1053 | def sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id: int) -> dict:
1054 |     """
1055 |     Синхронизирует статус Claude между памятью процесса и базой данных
1056 |     
1057 |     Возвращает обновленный статус диалога
1058 |     """
1059 |     try:
1060 |         print(f"🔄 Syncing Claude status for user {user_id}")
1061 |         
1062 |         # Получаем текущий статус из базы данных
1063 |         current_status = get_dialog_status(user_id)
1064 |         
1065 |         # Проверяем состояние в памяти процесса
1066 |         memory_status = "stopped"
1067 |         memory_enabled = False
1068 |         
1069 |         if user_id in user_conversations:
1070 |             conversation = user_conversations[user_id]
1071 |             memory_status = conversation.get("status", "stopped")
1072 |             memory_enabled = True
1073 |             
1074 |             # Синхронизируем статус Claude
1075 |             if memory_status == "active":
1076 |                 claude_status = "active"
1077 |             elif memory_status == "paused":
1078 |                 claude_status = "paused"
1079 |             else:
1080 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
1081 |         else:
1082 |             claude_status = "stopped"
1083 |         
1084 |         # Обновляем базу данных если есть расхождения
1085 |         db_claude_status = current_status.get("claude", {}).get("status", "stopped")
1086 |         db_claude_enabled = current_status.get("claude", {}).get("enabled", False)
1087 |         
1088 |         needs_update = (
1089 |             db_claude_status != claude_status or
1090 |             db_claude_enabled != memory_enabled
1091 |         )
1092 |         
1093 |         if needs_update:
1094 |             print(f"📝 Updating Claude status: {db_claude_status} -> {claude_status}, enabled: {db_claude_enabled} -> {memory_enabled}")
1095 |             
1096 |             update_dialog_status(
1097 |                 user_id=user_id,
1098 |                 claude_enabled=memory_enabled,
1099 |                 claude_status=claude_status,
1100 |                 claude_started_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat() if claude_status == "active" else None,
1101 |                 claude_paused_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat() if claude_status == "paused" else None
1102 |             )
1103 |             
1104 |             # Логируем событие синхронизации
1105 |             if claude_status == "active" and db_claude_status != "active":
1106 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_started", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1107 |             elif claude_status == "paused" and db_claude_status != "paused":
1108 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_paused", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1109 |             elif claude_status == "stopped" and db_claude_status != "stopped":
1110 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_stopped", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1111 |         
1112 |         # Возвращаем обновленный статус
1113 |         updated_status = get_dialog_status(user_id)
1114 |         print(f"✅ Claude status synced for user {user_id}: {claude_status}")
1115 |         
1116 |         return updated_status
1117 |         
1118 |     except Exception as e:
1119 |         print(f"❌ Error syncing Claude status for user {user_id}: {e}")
1120 |         import traceback
1121 |         traceback.print_exc()
1122 |         return get_dialog_status(user_id)  # Возвращаем базовый статус в случае ошибки

1185 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):
1186 |     """Claude генерирует текст и отправляет его на внутренний эндпоинт для доставки юзеру"""
1187 |     try:

1190 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден"}
1191 |         
1192 |         user_filters = user_conversations[user_id].get("filters") or {}
1193 |         days = user_filters.get('days', '')
1194 |         start_date = user_filters.get('start_date', '')
1195 |         end_date = user_filters.get('end_date', '')
1196 |         
1197 |         date_info = f"{start_date} — {end_date}" if start_date else f"{days} дн."
1198 |

1200 |         user_request = (

1202 |             f"Задай ОДИН короткий вопрос касающий потребности снять транспорт на Пхукете."
1203 |         )
1204 |         
1205 |         # 3. Получаем текст от Клода
1206 |         result = process_claude_message(user_id, user_request)
1207 |         
1208 |         if result.get("status") == "success":
1209 |             ai_text = result.get("response_text")
1210 |             
1211 |             # --- ОТПРАВКА НА ВАШ ЭНДПОИНТ ---
1212 |             internal_url = "http://localhost:5001/internal/send_message" # Проверьте ваш порт!
1213 |             payload = {
1214 |                 "user_id": user_id,
1215 |                 "text": ai_text
1216 |             }
1217 |             
1218 |             try:
1219 |                 # Отправляем POST запрос на ваш же бэкенд
1220 |                 response = requests.post(internal_url, json=payload, timeout=5)
1221 |                 
1222 |                 if response.status_code == 200:
1223 |                     print(f"✅ Квалификация успешно улетела через /internal/send_message для {user_id}")
1224 |                     result["delivered"] = True
1225 |                 else:
1226 |                     print(f"⚠️ Эндпоинт вернул ошибку {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
1227 |                     result["delivered"] = False
1228 |                     
1229 |             except Exception as e:
1230 |                 print(f"❌ Не удалось достучаться до внутреннего эндпоинта: {e}")
1231 |                 result["delivered"] = False
1232 |             # --------------------------------
1233 |             
1234 |         return result
1235 |         
1236 |     except Exception as e:
1237 |         print(f"❌ Ошибка в handle_claude_best_options: {e}")
1238 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1923 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1924 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1925 |     try:
1926 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1927 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1928 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1929 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1930 | 
1931 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1932 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1933 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1934 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1935 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1936 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1937 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1938 |     except Exception as e:
1939 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1950 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1951 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1952 |     try:
1953 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1954 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1955 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1956 | 
1957 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1958 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1959 | 
1960 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1961 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1962 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1963 | 
1964 |         # Фильтрация
1965 |         filtered = []
1966 |         for u in users_data:
1967 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1968 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1969 |             
1970 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1971 |             
1972 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1973 |             
1974 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1975 |                 filtered.append(u)
1976 | 
1977 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1978 | 
1979 |         return {
1980 |             "status": "ok",
1981 |             "users": filtered
1982 |         }
1983 |     except Exception as e:
1984 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1985 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1990 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1991 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1992 |     try:
1993 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1994 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1995 |         
1996 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1997 |         if period == "today":
1998 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1999 |         elif period == "week":
2000 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
2001 |         elif period == "2weeks":
2002 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
2003 |         elif period == "month":
2004 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
2005 |         else: # "all"
2006 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
2007 | 
2008 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
2009 |         stats = {
2010 |             "new": 0,
2011 |             "interested": 0,
2012 |             "pending": 0,
2013 |             "confirmed": 0,
2014 |             "completed": 0,
2015 |             "cancelled": 0,
2016 |             "no_response": 0,
2017 |             "archive": 0
2018 |         }
2019 | 
2020 |         for user in users_data:
2021 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
2022 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
2023 |             if not user_date_str:
2024 |                 continue
2025 |                 
2026 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
2027 |             
2028 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
2029 |             if user_date >= start_date:
2030 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
2031 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
2032 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
2033 |                 else:
2034 |                     status = user.get("status")
2035 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
2036 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
2037 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
2038 |                     
2039 |                     if status in stats:
2040 |                         stats[status] += 1
2041 | 
2042 |         return {
2043 |             "status": "ok",
2044 |             "period": period,
2045 |             "stats": stats
2046 |         }
2047 | 
2048 |     except Exception as e:
2049 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
2050 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2174 | def get_archive_users(period: str = Query("all", alias="period")):
2175 |     """Получить список архивных пользователей"""
2176 |     try:
2177 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
2178 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": [], "total": 0}
2179 | 
2180 |         with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2181 |             archive_data = json.load(f)
2182 | 
2183 |         # Группируем по user_id (последняя запись)
2184 |         latest_user_records = {}
2185 |         for event in archive_data:
2186 |             uid = event.get("user_id")
2187 |             if uid:
2188 |                 if uid not in latest_user_records or latest_user_records[uid].get("timestamp", "") < event.get("timestamp", ""):
2189 |                     latest_user_records[uid] = event
2190 |         
2191 |         users_data = list(latest_user_records.values())
2192 | 
2193 |         # Фильтр по периоду (по archived_at)
2194 |         if period != 'all':
2195 |             from datetime import timedelta
2196 |             now = datetime.utcnow()
2197 |             
2198 |             if period == 'week':
2199 |                 cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
2200 |             elif period == 'month':
2201 |                 cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
2202 |             else:
2203 |                 cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
2204 |             
2205 |             filtered = []
2206 |             for user in users_data:
2207 |                 archived_at = user.get('archived_at', user.get('timestamp', ''))
2208 |                 try:
2209 |                     user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(archived_at.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
2210 |                     if user_time >= cutoff:
2211 |                         filtered.append(user)
2212 |                 except:
2213 |                     continue
2214 |             
2215 |             users_data = filtered
2216 | 
2217 |         users_data.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('archived_at', x.get('timestamp', '')), reverse=True)
2218 | 
2219 |         return {
2220 |             "status": "ok",
2221 |             "users": users_data,
2222 |             "total": len(users_data)
2223 |         }
2224 |     except Exception as e:
2225 |         print(f"❌ Error in get_archive_users: {e}")
2226 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2631 |         except Exception as log_error:

2640 |             last_message_from="manager",
2641 |             message_count_increment=1
2642 |         )

2644 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2645 |         )
2646 |         
2647 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2648 |         try:
2649 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2650 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2651 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2652 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2653 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2654 |             
2655 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2656 |             
2657 |             response = requests.post(
2658 |                 internal_endpoint,
2659 |                 json={
2660 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2661 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2662 |                 },
2663 |                 timeout=10,
2664 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2665 |             )
2666 |

2668 |                 result = response.json()
2669 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2670 |                 return {
2671 |                     "status": "ok",

2674 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2675 |                 }

2678 |                 return {
2679 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2680 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2681 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2682 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2683 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2684 |                 }

2694 |             }

2703 | @app.post("/api/internal/receive-message")
2704 | async def receive_message_from_bot(request: Request):
2705 |     """Receive message from Telegram bot and log it"""
2706 |     try:
2707 |         data = await request.json()
2708 |         user_id = data.get('user_id')
2709 |         text = data.get('text')
2710 |         username = data.get('username')
2711 |         timestamp = data.get('timestamp')
2712 |         
2713 |         if not user_id or not text:
2714 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and text are required")
2715 |         
2716 |         print(f"📨 Received message from bot: user {user_id}, text: {text[:50]}...")
2717 |         
2718 |         # 1. Log message to chat history with role "user"
2719 |         try:
2720 |             chat_log_entry = {
2721 |                 "timestamp": timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2722 |                 "user_id": user_id,
2723 |                 "role": "user",
2724 |                 "text": text,
2725 |                 "username": username,
2726 |                 "source": "telegram_bot"
2727 |             }
2728 |             
2729 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2730 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2731 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {user_id}")
2732 |         except Exception as log_error:
2733 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2734 |         
2735 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: новое сообщение от пользователя
2736 |         update_dialog_status(
2737 |             user_id=user_id,
2738 |             active=True,
2739 |             has_new_messages=True,
2740 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2741 |             last_message_from="user",
2742 |             message_count_increment=1,
2743 |             username=username
2744 |         )
2745 |         log_dialog_event(user_id,action="receive_message_from_bot",timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
2746 |         
2747 |         # 3. Update user metadata (last message time) to move them up in CRM chat list
2748 |         try:
2749 |             users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
2750 |             user_updated = False
2751 |             
2752 |             for user in users_data:
2753 |                 if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
2754 |                     user['last_message_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2755 |                     user['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2756 |                     user_updated = True
2757 |                     break
2758 |             
2759 |             if user_updated:
2760 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2761 |                 print(f"✅ Updated metadata for user {user_id}")
2762 |             else:
2763 |                 print(f"⚠️ User {user_id} not found in user_data, creating new record")
2764 |                 # Create new user record if not exists
2765 |                 new_user = {
2766 |                     "user_id": user_id,
2767 |                     "username": username,
2768 |                     "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2769 |                     "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2770 |                     "status": "new",
2771 |                     "form_started": False,
2772 |                     "booking_submitted": False,
2773 |                     "car_interested": None,
2774 |                     "category_interested": None,
2775 |                     "dates_selected": None,
2776 |                     "notes": [],
2777 |                     "source": "telegram_bot",
2778 |                     "last_message_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2779 |                 }
2780 |                 users_data.append(new_user)
2781 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2782 |                 print(f"✅ Created new user record for {user_id}")
2783 |                 
2784 |         except Exception as metadata_error:
2785 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to update user metadata: {metadata_error}")
2786 |         
2787 |         return {
2788 |             "status": "ok",
2789 |             "message": "Message received and logged successfully"
2790 |         }
2791 |         
2792 |     except Exception as e:
2793 |         print(f"❌ Error in receive_message_from_bot: {e}")
2794 |         import traceback
2795 |         traceback.print_exc()
2796 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

3036 |         if owner_info.owner_id:
3037 |             # Сначала проверить, не связан ли этот автомобиль с другим владельцем
3038 |             for owner_id, owner in owners.items():
3039 |                 if car_id in owner.get("car_ids", {}):
3040 |                     # Удалить автомобиль из предыдущего владельца

3042 |                     owner["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
3043 |             
3044 |             # Добавить автомобиль к новому владельцу
3045 |             if owner_info.owner_id not in owners:
3046 |                 raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Owner with ID '{owner_info.owner_id}' not found")
3047 |             
3048 |             new_owner = owners[owner_info.owner_id]
3049 |             if car_id not in new_owner.get("car_ids", {}):
3050 |                 new_owner["car_ids"][car_id] = {

3052 |                     "status": "available",
3053 |                     "available_until": None,
3054 |                     "facebook_url": None,
3055 |                     "updated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
3056 |                 }
3057 |         
3058 |         # Найти владельца текущего автомобиля для обновления его данных
3059 |         current_owner = None
3060 |         current_owner_id = None
3061 |         for owner_id, owner in owners.items():
3062 |             if car_id in owner.get("car_ids", {}):
3063 |                 current_owner = owner
3064 |                 current_owner_id = owner_id
3065 |                 break
3066 |         
3067 |         if not current_owner:
3068 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Car '{car_id}' not found in any owner's inventory")
3069 |         
3070 |         car_data = current_owner["car_ids"][car_id]
3071 |

            user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
        
        result = handle_claude_best_options(user_id)
        return JSONResponse(content=result)
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in api_get_claude_best_options: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

# ==============================
# CLAUDE STATE MANAGEMENT ENDPOINTS
# ==============================

@app.post("/api/claude/start/{user_id}")
async def api_start_claude(user_id: int):
    """Запустить Claude AI для пользователя"""
    try:
        user_id = int(user_id)
        print(f"🚀 Starting Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # Создаем диалог если его нет
        if user_id not in user_conversations:
            user_conversations[user_id] = {
                "status": "active",
                "history": [],
                "filters": {}
            }
            if user_id not in user_sessions:
                user_sessions[user_id] = {}
            user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
        
        # Обновляем статус в памяти процесса
        user_conversations[user_id]["status"] = "active"
        
        # Синхронизируем с базой данных
        sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id)
        
        # Логируем событие
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_started", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "status": "success",
            "message": "Claude AI запущен",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "claude_status": "active"
        })
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error starting Claude for user {user_id}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.post("/api/claude/pause/{user_id}")
async def api_pause_claude(user_id: int):
    """Поставить на паузу Claude AI для пользователя"""
    try:
        user_id = int(user_id)
        print(f"⏸️ Pausing Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # Проверяем что диалог существует
        if user_id not in user_conversations:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Диалог не найден")
        
        # Обновляем статус в памяти процесса
        user_conversations[user_id]["status"] = "paused"
        
        # Синхронизируем с базой данных
        sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id)
        
        # Логируем событие
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_paused", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "status": "success",
            "message": "Claude AI поставлен на паузу",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "claude_status": "paused"
        })
        
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error pausing Claude for user {user_id}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.post("/api/claude/stop/{user_id}")
async def api_stop_claude(user_id: int):
    """Остановить Claude AI для пользователя"""
    try:
        user_id = int(user_id)
        print(f"🛑 Stopping Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # Проверяем что диалог существует
        if user_id not in user_conversations:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Диалог не найден")
        
        # Обновляем статус в памяти процесса
        user_conversations[user_id]["status"] = "stopped"
        
        # Синхронизируем с базой данных
        sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id)
        
        # Логируем событие
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_stopped", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "status": "success",
            "message": "Claude AI остановлен",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "claude_status": "stopped"
        })
        
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error stopping Claude for user {user_id}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

 356 | def check_booking_overlap(
 357 |     car_id: str,
 358 |     start_date: str,
 359 |     end_date: str,
 360 |     exclude_booking_id: Optional[str] = None
 361 |     ) -> Dict:
 362 |     """Проверяет есть ли пересечение дат для машины."""
 363 |     bookings = load_bookings()
 364 |     
 365 |     new_start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 366 |     new_end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 367 |     
 368 |     conflicting = []
 369 |     
 370 |     for booking in bookings:
 371 |         if exclude_booking_id and booking.get('booking_id') == exclude_booking_id:
 372 |             continue
 373 |             
 374 |         form_data = booking.get('form_data', {})
 375 |         if isinstance(form_data, dict):
 376 |             booking_car_id = form_data.get('car', {}).get('id')
 377 |         else:
 378 |             continue
 379 |             
 380 |         if booking_car_id != car_id:
 381 |             continue
 382 |         
 383 |         dates = form_data.get('dates', {})
 384 |         existing_start_str = dates.get('start')
 385 |         existing_end_str = dates.get('end')
 386 |         
 387 |         if not existing_start_str or not existing_end_str:
 388 |             continue
 389 |         
 390 |         existing_start = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_start_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 391 |         existing_end = datetime.fromisoformat(existing_end_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 392 |         
 393 |         if not (new_end <= existing_start or new_start >= existing_end):
 394 |             # ✅ Добавляем имя клиента и форматируем даты
 395 |             contact = form_data.get('contact', {})
 396 |             customer_name = contact.get('name', 'Неизвестный')
 397 |             
 398 |             conflicting.append({
 399 |                 "customer_name": customer_name,
 400 |                 "start": existing_start.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 401 |                 "end": existing_end.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"),
 402 |                 "booking_id": booking.get('booking_id')
 403 |             })
 404 |     
 405 |     return {
 406 |         "available": len(conflicting) == 0,
 407 |         "conflicting_bookings": conflicting
 408 |     }

 410 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
 411 |     """Надежно загружает JSON, возвращая список или словарь в зависимости от файла."""
 412 |     list_files = [BOOKINGS_FILE, USER_DATA_JSON, ARCHIVE_JSON]
 413 |     default = [] if path in list_files else {}
 414 |     if path == CARS_JSON:
 415 |         default = {"cars": {}}
 416 | 
 417 |     if not path.exists():
 418 |         if path in list_files:
 419 |             try:
 420 |                 path.write_text("[]", encoding="utf-8")
 421 |             except Exception:
 422 |                 pass
 423 |         return default
 424 | 
 425 |     try:
 426 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 427 |             content = f.read()
 428 |             if not content:
 429 |                 return default
 430 |             return json.loads(content)
 431 |     except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError):
 432 |         return default

 434 | def save_json(path: Path, data: Any):
 435 |     tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
 436 |     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 437 |         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
 438 |     os.replace(tmp, path)

 449 | def car_bookings(car: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
 450 |     return [
 451 |         {"start_date": b.get("start_date"), "end_date": b.get("end_date")}
 452 |         for b in (car.get("bookings") or car.get("Bookings") or [])
 453 |     ]
 454 | 
 455 | def overlaps(a1, a2, b1, b2):
 456 |     return not (a2 < b1 or b2 < a1)
 457 | 
 458 | def is_available(car: Dict, start: date, end: date, ext_bookings: Dict) -> bool:
 459 |     car_id = car.get("id") or car.get("name")
 460 |     all_b = car_bookings(car)
 461 |     if car_id in ext_bookings:
 462 |         all_b.extend(ext_bookings[car_id])
 463 |     for b in all_b:
 464 |         bs = _parse_date(b.get("start_date"))
 465 |         be = _parse_date(b.get("end_date"))
 466 |         if bs and be and overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
 467 |             return False
 468 |     return True
 469 | 
 470 | def _parse_date(s: str) -> Optional[date]:
 471 |     try:
 472 |         return date.fromisoformat(str(s))
 473 |     except:
 474 |         return None
 475 |

 477 |     return datetime.now().strftime("bk_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")

 525 | def move_to_archive(user_id: int):
 526 |     """Переместить пользователя в архив"""
 527 |     try:
 528 |         print(f"🗂️ Moving user {user_id} to archive...")
 529 |         
 530 |         # Читаем user_data
 531 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 532 |             print(f"❌ USER_DATA_JSON not found: {USER_DATA_JSON}")
 533 |             return False
 534 |         
 535 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 536 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 537 |         
 538 |         print(f"📊 Total records in user_data: {len(users_data)}")
 539 |         
 540 |         # Находим все записи пользователя
 541 |         user_records = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') == user_id]
 542 |         if not user_records:
 543 |             print(f"❌ User {user_id} not found in user_data")
 544 |             return False
 545 |         
 546 |         print(f"📋 Found {len(user_records)} records for user {user_id}")
 547 |         
 548 |         # Читаем архив
 549 |         if not ARCHIVE_JSON.exists():
 550 |             print(f"📁 Creating new archive file: {ARCHIVE_JSON}")
 551 |             archive_data = []
 552 |         else:
 553 |             with open(ARCHIVE_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 554 |                 archive_data = json.load(f)
 555 |         
 556 |         print(f"📊 Current archive size: {len(archive_data)} records")
 557 |         
 558 |         # Переносим в архив
 559 |         for record in user_records:
 560 |             record['archived_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
 561 |             archive_data.append(record)
 562 |         
 563 |         # Удаляем из user_data
 564 |         users_data = [u for u in users_data if u.get('user_id') != user_id]
 565 |         
 566 |         # Сохраняем
 567 |         with _lock:
 568 |             save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
 569 |             save_json(ARCHIVE_JSON, archive_data)
 570 |         
 571 |         print(f"✅ Moved user {user_id} to archive ({len(user_records)} records)")
 572 |         print(f"📊 New user_data size: {len(users_data)}")
 573 |         print(f"📊 New archive size: {len(archive_data)}")
 574 |         
 575 |         return True
 576 |         
 577 |     except Exception as e:
 578 |         print(f"❌ Error moving to archive: {e}")
 579 |         import traceback
 580 |         traceback.print_exc()
 581 |         return False

 626 | def auto_archive_old_records():
 627 |     """Автоматическая архивация старых записей"""
 628 |     try:
 629 |         from datetime import timedelta
 630 |         
 631 |         if not USER_DATA_JSON.exists():
 632 |             return {"archived": 0, "errors": 0}
 633 |         
 634 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 635 |             users_data = json.load(f)
 636 |         
 637 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
 638 |         to_archive = []
 639 |         
 640 |         # Правила архивации
 641 |         for user in users_data:
 642 |             timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 643 |             try:
 644 |                 user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 645 |             except:
 646 |                 continue
 647 |             
 648 |             age_days = (now - user_time).days
 649 |             status = user.get('final_status', '')
 650 |             
 651 |             # Правила:
 652 |             should_archive = False
 653 |             
 654 |             if status == 'new' and age_days > 14:
 655 |                 should_archive = True  # Новые > 2 недели
 656 |             elif status == 'awaiting_followup' and age_days > 30:
 657 |                 should_archive = True  # Теплые > 1 месяц
 658 |             elif status in ['rejected', 'new']:
 659 |                 should_archive = True  # Отказы и холодные сразу
 660 |             elif status == 'completed':
 661 |                 should_archive = True  # Завершенные сразу
 662 |             
 663 |             if should_archive:
 664 |                 to_archive.append(user.get('user_id'))
 665 |         
 666 |         # Архивируем
 667 |         archived_count = 0
 668 |         for user_id in set(to_archive):  # unique user_ids
 669 |             if move_to_archive(user_id):
 670 |                 archived_count += 1
 671 |         
 672 |         print(f"✅ Auto-archived {archived_count} users")
 673 |         return {"archived": archived_count, "errors": 0}
 674 |         
 675 |     except Exception as e:
 676 |         print(f"❌ Error in auto_archive: {e}")
 677 |         return {"archived": 0, "errors": 1}

 680 | def filter_by_period(users_data: list, period: str) -> list:
 681 |     """Фильтровать записи по периоду"""
 682 |     from datetime import timedelta
 683 |     
 684 |     if period == 'all':
 685 |         return users_data
 686 |     
 687 |     now = datetime.utcnow()
 688 |     
 689 |     # Определяем период
 690 |     if period == 'today':
 691 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=1)
 692 |     elif period == 'week':
 693 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
 694 |     elif period == '2weeks':
 695 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=14)
 696 |     elif period == 'month':
 697 |         cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
 698 |     else:
 699 |         return users_data
 700 |     
 701 |     # Фильтруем
 702 |     filtered = []
 703 |     for user in users_data:
 704 |         timestamp = user.get('timestamp', '')
 705 |         try:
 706 |             user_time = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 707 |             if user_time >= cutoff:
 708 |                 filtered.append(user)
 709 |         except:
 710 |             continue
 711 |     
 712 |     return filtered

 714 | def determine_category(car_name: str) -> str:
 715 |     car_name_lower = car_name.lower()
 716 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['yaris', 'ativ', 'city', 'mazda2', 'mg5']):
 717 |         return 'compact'
 718 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['civic', 'altis', 'camry', 'corolla']):
 719 |         return 'sedan'
 720 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['hrv', 'cx3', 'cx30', 'fortuner', 'xforce', 'mux']):
 721 |         return 'suv'
 722 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['xpander', 'veloz']):
 723 |         return '7s'
 724 |     if any(x in car_name_lower for x in ['pcx', 'click', 'bike', 'скутер', 'мото']):
 725 |         return 'bikes'
 726 |     return 'sedan'

 753 | def update_dialog_status(user_id: int, **kwargs):
 754 |     """
 755 |     Обновляет статус диалога в user_data.json
 756 |     
 757 |     Параметры:
 758 |     - active: bool
 759 |     - has_new_messages: bool
 760 |     - last_message_at: str (ISO datetime)
 761 |     - last_message_from: str ("user" | "manager" | "claude")
 762 |     - message_count_increment: int
 763 |     - claude_enabled: bool
 764 |     - claude_status: str ("active" | "paused" | "stopped")
 765 |     - claude_started_at: str
 766 |     - claude_paused_at: str
 767 |     """
 768 |     try:
 769 |         print(f"🔄 Updating dialog status for user {user_id}: {kwargs}")
 770 |         
 771 |         # Читаем user_data.json
 772 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
 773 |         
 774 |         # Найдем пользователя по user_id
 775 |         user_index = next((i for i, u in enumerate(users_data) if u.get("user_id") == user_id), None)
 776 |         
 777 |         if user_index is not None:

 889 | def get_dialog_status_from_history(user_id: int):
 890 |     """
 891 |     Получает статус диалога из истории событий и сообщений
 892 | 
 893 |     Возвращает:
 894 |     - active: bool - есть ли активный диалог
 895 |     - has_new_messages: bool - есть ли новые непрочитанные сообщения
 896 |     - last_message_at: str - время последнего сообщения
 897 |     - last_message_from: str - от кого последнее сообщение
 898 |     - message_count: int - количество сообщений в диалоге
 899 |     - claude_status: str - статус Claude (active/paused/stopped)
 900 |     """
 901 |     try:
 902 |         # Читаем события диалога из crm_history.jsonl
 903 |         history_file = DATA / "crm_history.jsonl"
 904 |         events = []
 905 |         if history_file.exists():
 906 |             with open(history_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 907 |                 for line in f:
 908 |                     try:
 909 |                         event = json.loads(line.strip())
 910 |                         if event.get("user_id") == user_id:
 911 |                             events.append(event)
 912 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 913 |                         continue
 914 | 
 915 |         # Читаем сообщения из chat_logs.jsonl
 916 |         chat_file = DATA / "chat_logs.jsonl"
 917 |         messages = []
 918 |         if chat_file.exists():
 919 |             with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 920 |                 for line in f:
 921 |                     try:
 922 |                         msg = json.loads(line.strip())
 923 |                         # Convert both to same type for comparison
 924 |                         msg_user_id = msg.get("user_id")
 925 |                         if str(msg_user_id) == str(user_id):
 926 |                             messages.append(msg)
 927 |                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
 928 |                         continue
 929 | 
 930 |         # Debug removed
 931 | 
 932 |         # Сортируем по времени
 933 |         events.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 934 |         messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
 935 | 
 936 |         # Анализируем события
 937 |         claude_status = "stopped"
 938 |         messages_marked_read = False
 939 | 
 940 |         # Определяем статус Claude из событий
 941 |         for event in events:
 942 |             action = event.get("action")
 943 |             if action == "claude_started":
 944 |                 claude_status = "active"
 945 |             elif action == "claude_paused":
 946 |                 claude_status = "paused"
 947 |             elif action == "claude_stopped":
 948 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
 949 |             elif action == "claude_resumed":
 950 |                 claude_status = "active"
 951 |             elif action == "messages_marked_read":
 952 |                 messages_marked_read = True
 953 | 
 954 |         # Анализируем сообщения
 955 |         message_count = len(messages)
 956 |         has_new_messages = False
 957 |         last_message_at = None
 958 |         last_message_from = None
 959 | 
 960 |         if messages:
 961 |             last_msg = messages[0]  # Уже отсортированы по времени
 962 |             last_message_at = last_msg.get("timestamp")
 963 |             last_message_from = last_msg.get("role")  # "user" или "assistant" (Claude)
 964 | 
 965 |             # Определяем новые сообщения: если последнее сообщение от пользователя и не отмечено как прочитанное
 966 |             if last_msg.get("role") == "user" and not messages_marked_read:
 967 |                 has_new_messages = True
 968 | 
 969 |         # Диалог активен если есть сообщения (независимо от времени) или Claude активен
 970 |         active = False
 971 |         if message_count > 0 or claude_status == "active":
 972 |             active = True
 973 | 
 974 |         return {
 975 |             "active": active,
 976 |             "has_new_messages": has_new_messages,
 977 |             "last_message_at": last_message_at,
 978 |             "last_message_from": last_message_from,
 979 |             "message_count": message_count,
 980 |             "claude_status": claude_status
 981 |         }
 982 | 
 983 |     except Exception as e:
 984 |         print(f"❌ Error getting dialog status for user {user_id}: {e}")
 985 |         return {
 986 |             "active": False,
 987 |             "has_new_messages": False,
 988 |             "last_message_at": None,
 989 |             "last_message_from": None,
 990 |             "message_count": 0,
 991 |             "claude_status": "stopped"
 992 |         }

1053 | def sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id: int) -> dict:
1054 |     """
1055 |     Синхронизирует статус Claude между памятью процесса и базой данных
1056 |     
1057 |     Возвращает обновленный статус диалога
1058 |     """
1059 |     try:
1060 |         print(f"🔄 Syncing Claude status for user {user_id}")
1061 |         
1062 |         # Получаем текущий статус из базы данных
1063 |         current_status = get_dialog_status(user_id)
1064 |         
1065 |         # Проверяем состояние в памяти процесса
1066 |         memory_status = "stopped"
1067 |         memory_enabled = False
1068 |         
1069 |         if user_id in user_conversations:
1070 |             conversation = user_conversations[user_id]
1071 |             memory_status = conversation.get("status", "stopped")
1072 |             memory_enabled = True
1073 |             
1074 |             # Синхронизируем статус Claude
1075 |             if memory_status == "active":
1076 |                 claude_status = "active"
1077 |             elif memory_status == "paused":
1078 |                 claude_status = "paused"
1079 |             else:
1080 |                 claude_status = "stopped"
1081 |         else:
1082 |             claude_status = "stopped"
1083 |         
1084 |         # Обновляем базу данных если есть расхождения
1085 |         db_claude_status = current_status.get("claude", {}).get("status", "stopped")
1086 |         db_claude_enabled = current_status.get("claude", {}).get("enabled", False)
1087 |         
1088 |         needs_update = (
1089 |             db_claude_status != claude_status or
1090 |             db_claude_enabled != memory_enabled
1091 |         )
1092 |         
1093 |         if needs_update:
1094 |             print(f"📝 Updating Claude status: {db_claude_status} -> {claude_status}, enabled: {db_claude_enabled} -> {memory_enabled}")
1095 |             
1096 |             update_dialog_status(
1097 |                 user_id=user_id,
1098 |                 claude_enabled=memory_enabled,
1099 |                 claude_status=claude_status,
1100 |                 claude_started_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat() if claude_status == "active" else None,
1101 |                 claude_paused_at=datetime.utcnow().isoformat() if claude_status == "paused" else None
1102 |             )
1103 |             
1104 |             # Логируем событие синхронизации
1105 |             if claude_status == "active" and db_claude_status != "active":
1106 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_started", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1107 |             elif claude_status == "paused" and db_claude_status != "paused":
1108 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_paused", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1109 |             elif claude_status == "stopped" and db_claude_status != "stopped":
1110 |                 log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_stopped", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
1111 |         
1112 |         # Возвращаем обновленный статус
1113 |         updated_status = get_dialog_status(user_id)
1114 |         print(f"✅ Claude status synced for user {user_id}: {claude_status}")
1115 |         
1116 |         return updated_status
1117 |         
1118 |     except Exception as e:
1119 |         print(f"❌ Error syncing Claude status for user {user_id}: {e}")
1120 |         import traceback
1121 |         traceback.print_exc()
1122 |         return get_dialog_status(user_id)  # Возвращаем базовый статус в случае ошибки

1154 |         print(f"Dialogue with user {user_id} is already active.")
1155 |         return {"status": "already_active", "message": "Диалог уже активен"}
1156 |     
1157 |     if user_id in user_sessions and user_sessions[user_id].get("claude_initiated"):
1158 |         print(f"Claude already initiated for user {user_id}.")
1159 |         return {"status": "already_initiated", "message": "Claude уже был инициализирован"}
1160 |     
1161 |     try:
1162 |         # Активируем диалог сразу

1171 |         user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True

1177 |         return {"status": "success", "message": "Диалог Claude запущен"}
1178 |

1185 | def handle_claude_best_options(user_id):
1186 |     """Claude генерирует текст и отправляет его на внутренний эндпоинт для доставки юзеру"""
1187 |     try:
1188 |         # 1. Получаем данные из диалогов (как и раньше)
1189 |         if user_id not in user_conversations:
1190 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден"}
1191 |         
1192 |         user_filters = user_conversations[user_id].get("filters") or {}
1193 |         days = user_filters.get('days', '')
1194 |         start_date = user_filters.get('start_date', '')
1195 |         end_date = user_filters.get('end_date', '')
1196 |         
1197 |         date_info = f"{start_date} — {end_date}" if start_date else f"{days} дн."
1198 | 
1199 |         # 2. Формируем краткий промпт (только квалификация)
1200 |         user_request = (
1201 |             f"Начни ответ СТРОГО с фразы: 'Ищешь что-то определенное? Могу подсказать.' "
1202 |             f"Задай ОДИН короткий вопрос касающий потребности снять транспорт на Пхукете."
1203 |         )
1204 |         
1205 |         # 3. Получаем текст от Клода
1206 |         result = process_claude_message(user_id, user_request)
1207 |         
1208 |         if result.get("status") == "success":
1209 |             ai_text = result.get("response_text")
1210 |             
1211 |             # --- ОТПРАВКА НА ВАШ ЭНДПОИНТ ---
1212 |             internal_url = "http://localhost:5001/internal/send_message" # Проверьте ваш порт!
1213 |             payload = {
1214 |                 "user_id": user_id,
1215 |                 "text": ai_text
1216 |             }
1217 |             
1218 |             try:
1219 |                 # Отправляем POST запрос на ваш же бэкенд
1220 |                 response = requests.post(internal_url, json=payload, timeout=5)
1221 |                 
1222 |                 if response.status_code == 200:
1223 |                     print(f"✅ Квалификация успешно улетела через /internal/send_message для {user_id}")
1224 |                     result["delivered"] = True
1225 |                 else:
1226 |                     print(f"⚠️ Эндпоинт вернул ошибку {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
1227 |                     result["delivered"] = False
1228 |                     
1229 |             except Exception as e:
1230 |                 print(f"❌ Не удалось достучаться до внутреннего эндпоинта: {e}")
1231 |                 result["delivered"] = False
1232 |             # --------------------------------
1233 |             
1234 |         return result
1235 |         
1236 |     except Exception as e:
1237 |         print(f"❌ Ошибка в handle_claude_best_options: {e}")
1238 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1241 | def process_claude_message(user_id, user_input):
1242 |     """Обрабатывает сообщение через Claude API"""
1243 |     try:
1244 |         print(f"🚀 process_claude_message called for {user_id}")
1245 |         
1246 |         if user_id not in user_conversations:
1247 |             print(f"❌ user_id {user_id} not in user_conversations!")
1248 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Пользователь не найден в активных диалогах"}
1249 |         
1250 |         if not claude_client:
1251 |             return {"status": "error", "message": "Claude клиент не инициализирован"}
1252 |         
1253 |         conversation_history = user_conversations[user_id]["history"]
1254 |         conversation_history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_input})
1255 | 
1256 |         # Формируем контекст с полной галереей
1257 |         cars_context = "\n\nДОСТУПНЫЕ МАШИНЫ:\n"
1258 |         
1259 |         if CAR_LIST_JSON and 'cars' in CAR_LIST_JSON:
1260 |             for car_id, car in CAR_LIST_JSON['cars'].items():
1261 |                 # Пропускаем недоступные
1262 |                 if not car.get('available', True):
1263 |                     continue
1264 |                 
1265 |                 name = car.get('name', 'Без названия')
1266 |                 car_class = car.get('class', '').upper()
1267 |                 
1268 |                 # Цены
1269 |                 pricing = car.get('pricing', {})
1270 |                 season_pricing = pricing.get('high_season', {}) or pricing.get('low_season', {})
1271 |                 
1272 |                 p_1_6 = season_pricing.get('price_1_6', 0)
1273 |                 p_7_14 = season_pricing.get('price_7_14', 0)
1274 |                 p_15_29 = season_pricing.get('price_15_29', 0)
1275 |                 p_30 = season_pricing.get('price_30_plus', 0)
1276 |                 deposit = pricing.get('deposit', 5000)
1277 |

1923 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/gallery")
1924 | def list_gallery(dir: str = Query(..., alias="dir")):
1925 |     try:
1926 |         rel = unquote(dir).lstrip("/")
1927 |         abs_dir = IMAGES / rel
1928 |         if not abs_dir.is_dir() or not str(abs_dir).startswith(str(IMAGES)):
1929 |             raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid folder")
1930 | 
1931 |         exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif"}
1932 |         files = [f for f in os.listdir(abs_dir) if (abs_dir / f).is_file() and Path(f).suffix.lower() in exts]
1933 |         files_1 = [f for f in files if f.lower() == "1.jpg"]
1934 |         files_rest = sorted(f for f in files if f.lower() != "1.jpg")
1935 |         ordered = files_1 + files_rest
1936 |         images = [f"/images_web/{rel}/{f}" for f in ordered]
1937 |         return {"folder": dir, "count": len(images), "images": images}
1938 |     except Exception as e:
1939 |         raise HTTPException(400, str(e))

1950 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/users")
1951 | def get_crm_users(status: str, period: str = "week"):
1952 |     try:
1953 |         # Проверка существования файла через os.path
1954 |         if not os.path.exists(USER_DATA_JSON):
1955 |             return {"status": "ok", "users": []}
1956 | 
1957 |         with open(USER_DATA_JSON, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
1958 |             users_data = json.load(f)
1959 | 
1960 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1961 |         delta = {"today": 1, "week": 7, "month": 30}.get(period, 9999)
1962 |         start_date = now - timedelta(days=delta)
1963 | 
1964 |         # Фильтрация
1965 |         filtered = []
1966 |         for u in users_data:
1967 |             u_status = u.get("status")
1968 |             u_at = u.get("created_at")
1969 |             
1970 |             if not u_at or not u_status: continue
1971 |             
1972 |             u_date = datetime.fromisoformat(u_at.replace('Z', ''))
1973 |             
1974 |             if u_status == status and u_date >= start_date and not u.get("archived"):
1975 |                 filtered.append(u)
1976 | 
1977 |         filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""), reverse=True)
1978 | 
1979 |         return {
1980 |             "status": "ok",
1981 |             "users": filtered
1982 |         }
1983 |     except Exception as e:
1984 |         # Теперь мы увидим более детальную ошибку, если она случится
1985 |         return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}

1990 | @app.get(API_PREFIX + "/crm/stats")
1991 | def get_crm_stats(period: str = Query("week")):
1992 |     try:
1993 |         users_data = load_json(USER_DATA_JSON)
1994 |         now = datetime.utcnow()
1995 |         
1996 |         # Определяем точку отсчета для фильтра
1997 |         if period == "today":
1998 |             start_date = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
1999 |         elif period == "week":
2000 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=7)
2001 |         elif period == "2weeks":
2002 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=14)
2003 |         elif period == "month":
2004 |             start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)
2005 |         else: # "all"
2006 |             start_date = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
2007 | 
2008 |         # Инициализируем счетчики (согласно src/types/crm.ts)
2009 |         stats = {
2010 |             "new": 0,
2011 |             "interested": 0,
2012 |             "pending": 0,
2013 |             "confirmed": 0,
2014 |             "completed": 0,
2015 |             "cancelled": 0,
2016 |             "no_response": 0,
2017 |             "archive": 0
2018 |         }
2019 | 
2020 |         for user in users_data:
2021 |             # Парсим дату создания лида
2022 |             user_date_str = user.get("created_at") or user.get("timestamp")
2023 |             if not user_date_str:
2024 |                 continue
2025 |                 
2026 |             user_date = datetime.fromisoformat(user_date_str.replace('Z', ''))
2027 |             
2028 |             # Проверяем, попадает ли юзер в период
2029 |             if user_date >= start_date:
2030 |                 # Если юзер в архиве, считаем его отдельно
2031 |                 if user.get("archived") is True:
2032 |                     stats["archive"] += 1
2033 |                 else:
2034 |                     status = user.get("status")
2035 |                     # Маппинг на случай, если в базе остались старые статусы
2036 |                     if status == "in_progress": status = "interested"
2037 |                     if status in ["hot", "booked"]: status = "pending"
2038 |                     
2039 |                     if status in stats:
2040 |                         stats[status] += 1
2041 | 
2042 |         return {
2043 |             "status": "ok",
2044 |             "period": period,
2045 |             "stats": stats
2046 |         }
2047 | 
2048 |     except Exception as e:
2049 |         print(f"Stats Error: {e}")
2050 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2615 |     try:
2616 |         print(f"[send_message] user_id={msg_request.user_id}, text={msg_request.text[:50]}...")
2617 |         
2618 |         # 1. Логируем сообщение в CHAT_LOGS_JSONL с ролью "manager"
2619 |         try:
2620 |             chat_log_entry = {
2621 |                 "timestamp": msg_request.timestamp or datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
2622 |                 "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2623 |                 "role": "manager",
2624 |                 "text": msg_request.text,
2625 |                 "source": "crm_panel"
2626 |             }
2627 |             
2628 |             with open(CHAT_LOGS_JSONL, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2629 |                 f.write(json.dumps(chat_log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
2630 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {msg_request.user_id}")
2631 |         except Exception as log_error:
2632 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2633 |             # Продолжаем выполнение даже если логирование не удалось
2634 |         
2635 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: сообщение от менеджера
2636 |         update_dialog_status(
2637 |             user_id=msg_request.user_id,
2638 |             active=True,
2639 |             last_message_at=datetime.now().isoformat(),
2640 |             last_message_from="manager",
2641 |             message_count_increment=1
2642 |         )
2643 |         log_dialog_event(msg_request.user_id, action="manager_message_sent",
2644 |             timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2645 |         )
2646 |         
2647 |         # 3. Отправляем сообщение через внутренний endpoint telegram бота
2648 |         try:
2649 |             # Определяем URL внутреннего endpoint'а бота
2650 |             bot_internal_url = os.getenv("TG_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://localhost:5001")
2651 |             if bot_internal_url.endswith('/'):
2652 |                 bot_internal_url = bot_internal_url[:-1]
2653 |             internal_endpoint = f"{bot_internal_url}/internal/send_message"
2654 |             
2655 |             print(f"📤 Sending message to bot internal endpoint: {internal_endpoint}")
2656 |             
2657 |             response = requests.post(
2658 |                 internal_endpoint,
2659 |                 json={
2660 |                     "user_id": msg_request.user_id,
2661 |                     "text": msg_request.text
2662 |                 },
2663 |                 timeout=10,
2664 |                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
2665 |             )
2666 |             
2667 |             if response.status_code == 200:
2668 |                 result = response.json()
2669 |                 print(f"✅ Message sent to user {msg_request.user_id} via bot")
2670 |                 return {
2671 |                     "status": "ok",
2672 |                     "message": "Message sent successfully",
2673 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2674 |                     "sent_via_bot": True
2675 |                 }
2676 |             else:
2677 |                 print(f"⚠️ Bot returned status {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
2678 |                 return {
2679 |                     "status": "partial_success",
2680 |                     "message": "Message logged but failed to send via bot",
2681 |                     "logged_to_history": True,
2682 |                     "sent_via_bot": False,
2683 |                     "bot_error": f"Status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
2684 |                 }
2685 |                 
2686 |         except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
2687 |             print(f"⚠️ Error connecting to bot: {e}")
2688 |             return {
2689 |                 "status": "partial_success",
2690 |                 "message": "Message logged but bot unreachable",
2691 |                 "logged_to_history": True,
2692 |                 "sent_via_bot": False,
2693 |                 "bot_error": str(e)
2694 |             }
2695 |             
2696 |     except Exception as e:
2697 |         print(f"❌ Error in send_message: {e}")
2698 |         import traceback
2699 |         traceback.print_exc()
2700 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

2714 |             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="user_id and text are required")
2715 |         
2716 |         print(f"📨 Received message from bot: user {user_id}, text: {text[:50]}...")
2717 |         
2718 |         # 1. Log message to chat history with role "user"
2719 |         try:

2731 |             print(f"✅ Message logged to chat history for user {user_id}")

2733 |             print(f"⚠️ Failed to log message to chat history: {log_error}")
2734 |         
2735 |         # 2. ✅ ОБНОВЛЯЕМ СТАТУС ДИАЛОГА: новое сообщение от пользователя

2751 |

2753 |                 if user.get('user_id') == user_id:
2754 |                     user['last_message_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2755 |                     user['updated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2756 |                     user_updated = True
2757 |                     break
2758 |             
2759 |             if user_updated:
2760 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2761 |                 print(f"✅ Updated metadata for user {user_id}")
2762 |             else:
2763 |                 print(f"⚠️ User {user_id} not found in user_data, creating new record")
2764 |                 # Create new user record if not exists

2777 |                     "source": "telegram_bot",
2778 |                     "last_message_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
2779 |                 }
2780 |                 users_data.append(new_user)
2781 |                 save_json(USER_DATA_JSON, users_data)
2782 |                 print(f"✅ Created new user record for {user_id}")

2784 |         except Exception as metadata_error:

@app.post("/api/claude/start/{user_id}")
async def api_start_claude(user_id: int):
    """Запустить Claude AI для пользователя"""
    try:
        user_id = int(user_id)
        print(f"🚀 Starting Claude for user {user_id}")
        
        # Создаем диалог если его нет
        if user_id not in user_conversations:
            user_conversations[user_id] = {
                "status": "active",
                "history": [],
                "filters": {}
            }
            if user_id not in user_sessions:
                user_sessions[user_id] = {}
            user_sessions[user_id]["claude_initiated"] = True
        
        # Устанавливаем статус active
        user_conversations[user_id]["status"] = "active"
        
        # Синхронизируем с базой данных
        sync_claude_status_with_memory(user_id)
        
        # Логируем событие
        log_dialog_event(user_id, action="claude_started", timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat())
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "status": "success",
            "message": "Claude AI запущен",
            "user_id": user_id,
            "claude_status": "active"
        })
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error starting Claude for user {user_id}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

  88 |   const [dialogFilter, setDialogFilter] = useState<'all' | 'new' | 'ai-on' | 'ai-off'>('all');

  95 |   const formatDateSimple = (dateStr: string) => {
  96 |     if (!dateStr) return '—';
  97 |     return dayjs(dateStr).format('DD.MM.YYYY');
  98 |   };
  99 | 
 100 |   const getDaysCount = (start: any, end: any) => {
 101 |     if (!start || !end) return 0;
 102 |     const s = dayjs(start);
 103 |     const e = dayjs(end);
 104 |     const d = e.diff(s, 'day');
 105 |     return d <= 0 ? 1 : d;
 106 |   };
 107 | 
 108 |   const getFilteredUsers = (users: User[]): User[] => {
 109 |     return users.filter(user => {
 110 |       const dialog = user.dialog_status;
 111 | 
 112 |       if (dialogFilter === 'new') {
 113 |         return dialog?.has_new_messages;
 114 |       }
 115 |       if (dialogFilter === 'ai-on') {
 116 |         return dialog?.claude_status === 'active';
 117 |       }
 118 |       if (dialogFilter === 'ai-off') {
 119 |         return dialog?.active && dialog?.claude_status !== 'active';
 120 |       }
 121 |       return true;
 122 |     });
 123 |   };
 124 | 
 125 |   const formatRelativeTime = (dateStr: string): string => {
 126 |     if (!dateStr) return '—';
 127 |     
 128 |     const now = dayjs();
 129 |     const date = dayjs(dateStr);
 130 |     const diffInMinutes = now.diff(date, 'minute');
 131 |     
 132 |     if (diffInMinutes < 1) return 'только что';
 133 |     if (diffInMinutes < 60) return `${diffInMinutes} мин назад`;
 134 |     
 135 |     const diffInHours = now.diff(date, 'hour');
 136 |     if (diffInHours < 24) return `${diffInHours} ч назад`;
 137 |     
 138 |     const diffInDays = now.diff(date, 'day');
 139 |     if (diffInDays < 7) return `${diffInDays} дн назад`;
 140 |     
 141 |     return date.format('DD.MM.YY');
 142 |   };

 144 |   const loadMainData = useCallback(async () => {
 145 |     setLoading(true);
 146 |     try {

 149 |         fetch(`/api/crm/stats?period=${period}`)

 151 |       const uData = await uRes.json();

 153 |       if (uData.status === 'ok') {

 156 |         setTimeout(() => refreshAllDialogStatuses(), 1000);

 159 |     } catch (e) { console.error("Ошибка загрузки:", e); }
 160 |     finally { setLoading(false); }
 161 |   }, [activeStatus, period]);

 163 | const fetchChatHistory = async (userId) => {
 164 |   try {
 165 |     const response = await fetch(`/api/crm/chats/${userId}`);
 166 |     const data = await response.json();
 167 |     if (data.status === 'ok' && data.chats) {
 168 |       // Добавляем проверку m !== null
 169 |       const uniqueChats = data.chats.filter((msg, index, self) => 
 170 |         msg && index === self.findIndex((m) => m && (
 171 |           (m.id && m.id === msg.id) || 
 172 |           (m.timestamp === msg.timestamp && (m.content === msg.content || m.text === msg?.text))
 173 |         ))
 174 |       );
 175 |       setChats(uniqueChats);
 176 |     }
 177 |   } catch (e) {
 178 |     console.error("Ошибка:", e);
 179 |   }
 180 | };
 181 | const loadUserDetails = async (user: any) => {
 182 |   setSelectedUser(user);
 183 |   setIsDetailsOpen(true);
 184 |   setChats([]); // Сбрасываем старый чат
 185 |   setBookings([]);
 186 |   
 187 |   try {
 188 |     const [cRes, bRes] = await Promise.all([
 189 |       fetch(`/api/crm/chats/${user.user_id}`),
 190 |       fetch(`/api/crm/bookings/${user.user_id}`)
 191 |     ]);
 192 |     
 193 |     const cData = await cRes.json();
 194 |     const bData = await bRes.json();
 195 | 
 196 |     if (cData.status === 'ok' && cData.chats) {
 197 |       // ФИЛЬТР: оставляем только те объекты, которые не null и имеют текст
 198 |       const validChats = cData.chats.filter(msg => msg !== null && (msg.content || msg.text));
 199 |       setChats(validChats);
 200 |     }
 201 |     
 202 |     if (bData.status === 'ok') setBookings(bData.bookings);
 203 |     
 204 |     await fetchClaudeStatus(user.user_id);
 205 |     setTimeout(scrollToBottom, 100);

 245 |   const refreshAllDialogStatuses = async () => {
 246 |     try {

 256 |       const results = await Promise.allSettled(promises);
 257 |       setUsers(prev => prev.map(user => {

 259 |         if (result && result.status === 'fulfilled' && result.value.dialogStatus) {
 260 |           return { ...user, dialog_status: result.value.dialogStatus };

 320 |   const handleClaudeAction = async (userId: number, action: 'start' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'stop') => {
 321 |     setLoadingAction(prev => ({ ...prev, [`claude_${userId}_${action}`]: true }));
 322 |     try {

 324 |         method: 'POST',
 325 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 326 |         body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: userId })
 327 |       });
 328 |       const result = await response.json();
 329 |       
 330 |       if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'ok') {
 331 |         if (action === 'start' || action === 'resume') {
 332 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 333 |             ...prev,
 334 |             [userId]: 'active'
 335 |           }));
 336 |         } else if (action === 'pause') {
 337 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 338 |             ...prev,
 339 |             [userId]: 'paused'
 340 |           }));
 341 |         } else if (action === 'stop') {
 342 |           setClaudeStatuses(prev => ({
 343 |             ...prev,
 344 |             [userId]: 'stopped'
 345 |           }));
 346 |         }
 347 |         console.log(`✅ Claude ${action} для пользователя ${userId}:`, result.message || result);
 348 |         alert(`✅ Действие "${action}" выполнено успешно для пользователя ${userId}`);
 349 |       } else {
 350 |         console.error(`❌ Ошибка ${action} Claude:`, result.message || result);
 351 |         alert(`❌ Ошибка выполнения действия "${action}": ${result.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка'}`);
 352 |       }
 353 |     } catch (e) {
 354 |       console.error(`❌ Ошибка ${action} Claude:`, e);
 355 |       alert(`❌ Ошибка сети при выполнении действия "${action}"`);
 356 |     }
 357 |     finally {
 358 |       setLoadingAction(prev => ({ ...prev, [`claude_${userId}_${action}`]: false }));
 359 |     }
 360 |   };

      // Добавляем проверку m !== null

          (m.timestamp === msg.timestamp && (m.content === msg.content || m.text === msg?.text))

      );
      setChats(uniqueChats);

  } catch (e) {

  }
};

 528 | def log_chat_to_file(user_id, role, content):
 529 |     """Логирует сообщение в файл chat_logs.jsonl."""
 530 |     if not LOGS_FILE:
 531 |         print(f"⚠️ LOGS_FILE не определен. Логирование в файл отключено.")
 532 |         return
 533 |     try:
 534 |         log_entry = {
 535 |             "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
 536 |             "user_id": user_id,
 537 |             "role": role,  # "user" или "assistant"
 538 |             "content": content
 539 |         }
 540 |         # 'a' - append (добавление в конец файла)
 541 |         with open(LOGS_FILE, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
 542 |             f.write(json.dumps(log_entry, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
 543 |     except Exception as e:
 544 |         print(f"❌ CRITICAL: Не удалось записать лог в {LOGS_FILE}: {e}")

 551 | def call_backend_api(endpoint, data=None, method="POST"):
 552 |     """Вызывает API эндпойнт бэкенда"""
 553 |     try:
 554 |         backend_url = "http://localhost:5000"
 555 |         url = f"{backend_url}{endpoint}"
 556 |         
 557 |         if method == "POST":
 558 |             response = requests.post(url, json=data, timeout=10)
 559 |         elif method == "GET":
 560 |             response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
 561 |         else:
 562 |             raise ValueError(f"Unsupported method: {method}")
 563 |             
 564 |         if response.status_code == 200:
 565 |             return response.json()
 566 |         else:
 567 |             print(f"⚠️ Backend API error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
 568 |             return None
 569 |     except Exception as e:
 570 |         print(f"❌ Error calling backend API {endpoint}: {e}")
 571 |         return None
 572 |

 591 |     except Exception as e:

 593 |         import traceback

def call_backend_api(endpoint, data=None, method="POST"):
    """Вызывает API эндпойнт бэкенда"""
    try:
        backend_url = "http://localhost:5000"
        url = f"{backend_url}{endpoint}"
        
        if method == "POST":
            response = requests.post(url, json=data, timeout=10)
        elif method == "GET":
            response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported method: {method}")
            
        if response.status_code == 200:
            return response.json()
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ Backend API error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
            return None
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error calling backend API {endpoint}: {e}")
        return None

 249 | def is_date_overlap(start1, end1, start2, end2):
 250 |     try:
 251 |         s1 = datetime.fromisoformat(start1.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 252 |         e1 = datetime.fromisoformat(end1.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 253 |         s2 = datetime.fromisoformat(start2.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 254 |         e2 = datetime.fromisoformat(end2.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
 255 |         return s1 <= e2 and s2 <= e1
 256 |     except Exception as e:
 257 |         print(f"Error in is_date_overlap: {e}")
 258 |         print(f"start1: {start1}, end1: {end1}, start2: {start2}, end2: {end2}")
 259 |         raise
